 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

With the MCP framework moving to GA, this is a present-tense story, and you'll be the one who tells it credibly. 
 
 What You'll Own 
 
 Positioning and messaging for the Foundation pillar — platform, data, infrastructure, identity and matching, APIs and the MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and workflows. You set the narrative and keep it coherent with the Intelligence and Activation pillars.

title: Senior Expansion Manager:in (m/w/d) für Standortakquise in München
description:
Realisiere mit Fastned die Mobilität von morgen!

Wir wollen unser Expansionsteam für die Region Süd rund um München verstärken. 

Die Mobilität verändert sich grundlegend. Elektrofahrzeuge werden zum Alltag, neue Technologien entwickeln sich rasant und der Bedarf an leistungsfähiger Ladeinfrastruktur wächst. Fastned gestaltet als Unternehmen für ultraschnelles Laden diese Entwicklung aktiv mit.

Als Pionier im Bereich der Schnellladeinfrastruktur haben wir es uns zum Ziel gesetzt, bis 2030 ein europaweites Netz von über 1.000 Schnellladestationen aufzubauen.

Dafür arbeiten mehr als 500 Kolleg:innen aus über 50 Nationen in zehn Ländern zusammen. Bei Fastned triffst du auf Menschen aus unterschiedlichsten Fachbereichen und Kulturen, die eine gemeinsame Mission verbindet: Wir wollen die Mobilitätswende beschleunigen und Elektromobilität für alle zugänglicher machen.

Ein Job an der Schnittstelle von Immobilien, innovativer Technologie und Nachhaltigkeit

Als Senior Expansion Manager:in entscheidest du mit, wo die nächste Generation unserer Schnellladestationen entsteht. Du identifizierst attraktive Standorte in deiner Region, sprichst Eigentümer:innen, Projektentwickler:innen, Unternehmen und Kommunen an und entwickelst daraus langfristige Partnerschaften.

Du arbeitest in einer innovativen und schnell wachsenden Branche, in der sich Markt, Technologie und rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Dabei verbindest du dein Immobilien- und Verhandlungsgeschick mit einem konkreten Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Mobilität.

title: Palveluesihenkilöitä pääkaupunkiseudulle
description: Oletko tulosorientoitunut siivousalan osaaja, joka viihtyy vastuullisessa esihenkilötehtävässä? Langat eivät putoa käsistäsi kiireenkään keskellä? Saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö!Etsimme nyt kasvavaan joukkoomme kahta  Palveluesihenkilöä pääkaupunkiseudulle! Siivouksen esihenkilö- ja ohjaustehtävissä tulet vastaamaan asiakaskohteidemme siivouspalveluiden operatiivisesta suunnittelusta ja sujuvuudesta. Hakemamme tekijä on aidosti palveluhenkinen, asiakaslähtöinen ja viihtyy ajoittain kiireisessäkin työympäristössä organisoiden työnsä tehokkaasti - unohtamatta timanttista ongelmanratkontakykyä!  Tehtävissä menestyminen edellyttää aikaisempaa kokemusta siivousalalta, työnjohdollisista tehtävistä sekä asiakkuuksien tuloksellisesta johtamisesta. Hakemamme henkilön tulee kyetä kommunikoimaan vaivatta niin suomeksi kuin englanniksi ja aidosti viihtyä monikulttuurisessa työympäristössä.Tehtävänkuvan keskiössä ovat myös vahvat vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot sekä kyky toimia itseohjautuvassa esihenkilöroolissa - esimerkillä johtaminen ja alaisten motivoiminen ovat osa päivittäistä tekemistä. Tässä työssä tulet tarvitsemaan ajokorttia, oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Myös alan ammattitutkinnosta on sinulle etua.  Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan juuri sinulle sopivalla tavalla.RTK-Palvelu tarjoaa osaajilleen kattavan perehdytyksen ja sisäisten koulutus- ja etenemismahdollisuuksien lisäksi täyden tuen ammattitutkintojen suorittamiseen työn ohessa.Yrityksessämme vaalitaan hyvää työilmapiiriä ja auttamisen kulttuuria – tukenasi ovat osaavat kollegat ja kannustava esihenkilö.Meille on myös tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi! – vuosittaisessa työvirekyselyssä saimme työntekijäkokemuksesta erinomaisen arvosanan 4,1/5.Työsuhde solmitaan toistaiseksi voimassa olevana ja töiden aloitus on sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika tehtävissä on kokoaikainen. Palkkaus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan, aiempi kokemus- ja koulutustaustasi huomioiden. Työsuhteessa sovelletaan kiinteistöalan toimihenkilöitä koskevaa työehtosopimusta. Jos koet hyvän työyhteisön olevan sinulle merkityksellinen, viihdyt meillä varmasti!  Lähetä hakemuksesi tai vinkkaa kaverille, toimi kuitenkin mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelut aloitetaan

title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.
  • B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. title: Senior ICT System Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle als ICT System Engineer

Als erfahrener ICT System Engineer bist du ein essenzieller Teil unseres Teams. Du planst, realisierst und optimierst moderne ICT-Plattformen und stellst deren sicheren, stabilen und leistungsfähigen Betrieb sicher. title: IT Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is a pioneering international deep-tech company with locations in Germany and the US, dedicated to commercializing laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to deliver clean, safe, and virtually limitless energy to the world. As we rapidly scale, we seek talented individuals who thrive on bringing clarity and structure to fast-growing environments.

About the Role

Focused Energy’s German operations are growing, and the IT systems supporting that growth need an engineer who can own their operation with confidence. As an IT Systems Engineer, you’ll ensure that Focused Energy’s Darmstadt IT environment runs reliably, securely, and efficiently across device management, endpoint security, cloud services, access management, and automation.

 

This is a systems ownership role, with end-user support as a secondary responsibility. You’ll work onsite in Darmstadt, collaborate with colleagues across Berlin and Austin, and help build a more stable, automated, and scalable IT environment for the scientists and engineers developing fusion technology.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the operation and maintenance of IT systems and infrastructure in Darmstadt, including MDM, endpoint security, cloud services, device lifecycle, and access management.

  • Lead automation and scripting initiatives that reduce repetitive manual work, improve consistency, and increase operational efficiency.

  • Manage onboarding and offboarding IT execution, including account provisioning, device readiness, access management, and access revocation.

title: Business Unit Leader, Expert-Assisted Services  (d/f/m)
description:
Our story

Every year, millions struggle with tax filing or miss out on tax refunds. We’re fixing that. Our intuitive app empowers everyone, regardless of background, to file taxes confidently.

 

Operating across Germany, Spain, and the UK, Taxfix Group (Taxfix and Steuerbot) is a team of over 400 professionals—tax experts, developers, and IT specialists—committed to solutions. Since 2016, we’ve enabled over 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for our customers.

 

The opportunity

Taxfix is creating expert-assisted digital tax services, blending software, AI, and licensed human expertise for easier filings. We're hiring a Business Unit Leader, Expert-Assisted Services to drive and scale this business area as a key growth engine.

 

This senior role requires commercial and general management skills—defining customer segments, service design, pricing, demand generation, conversion, retention, and efficient scaling without compromising trust or quality. You’ll balance growth, margin, capacity, costs, and outcomes, working closely with peers across Product, Operations, Marketing/Growth, Data, and Finance, and aligning teams to business and commercial goals.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Business leadership: Set ambition, priorities, and execution plans, owning revenue, margin, conversion, retention, and outcomes.

  • Customer strategy: Identify high-value segments and craft differentiated propositions and journeys.

title: Senior Finance Operations Leader – Accounting (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your challenge

As our Senior Finance Operations Leader – Accounting, you will lead the accounting and treasury organisation behind Taxfix’s growing multi-country business.

Your focus will be on creating reliable, scalable and well-controlled finance operations across Group and statutory accounting, month-end and year-end close, consolidation, audit readiness, treasury and core Record-to-Report processes.

You will lead an experienced team, establish clear priorities and ownership, and ensure that our accounting organisation delivers accurate and timely financial information. At the same time, you will continuously improve how the team works through stronger processes, documentation and pragmatic automation.

Tax and Finance Systems Transformation are managed separately. You will collaborate closely with these teams where their work intersects with accounting and treasury, but they are not part of your direct remit.

title: Frontend Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Who We Are

Manufacturing runs on fragmented data: machines, sensors and decade-old systems that don't talk to each other. Data sits in departmental silos, knowledge lives in people's heads, and AI can't unfold its potential in point solutions that don't deliver. At Manex AI, we build the missing layer. Our platform handles manufacturing data at scale, models the factory ontology and builds agentic applications that reason and act across it.

We're a fast-growing team in Munich, backed by Lightspeed and BlueYard, with engineers from top companies and leading enterprise manufacturers as customers. We ship fast, work close to the shop floor, and we don't ship things we're not proud of.

The Role

As Frontend Engineer, you'll work across our entire frontend ecosystem and own frontend systems end-to-end. You'll use AI to ship a high volume of polished work while making thoughtful architectural decisions that keep our frontend coherent and easy to extend. You'll work directly with founders, engineers and customers, and see your work used on real factory floors.

What You'll Do

  • Platform: Build the interface for Kosmos, the platform that brings together enterprise data, operational context and AI

  • Applications: Build interfaces for manufacturing applications that run on and are embedded into Kosmos

  • Framework & DX: Ship the components, conventions, tooling and guidance that help AI agents, full-stack engineers and forward-deployed engineers build better UI faster

description: Ben jij een ervaren people manager met een sterke achtergrond binnen Customer Service en krijg je energie van het ontwikkelen van mensen, verbeteren van de klantbeleving en het professionaliseren van processen? Voor een dynamische organisatie in de Rotterdamse haven zijn wij op zoek naar een Customer Service Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor een team van 6 Customer Service Professionals.   Omschrijving   In deze functie ligt de focus nadrukkelijk op leidinggeven, ontwikkelen en verbeteren. Je bent niet verantwoordelijk voor het zelf uitvoeren van operationele Customer Service-werkzaamheden, maar zorgt ervoor dat het team optimaal functioneert en continu stappen maakt in kwaliteit, performance en customer experience.   Wat ga je doen?   Als Customer Service Manager geef je direct leiding aan een team van 6 Customer Service Professionals. Je creëert duidelijkheid, structuur en ontwikkeling binnen het team en zorgt ervoor dat de dienstverlening continu wordt verbeterd.  Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:    Aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team van circa 6 FTE.    Voeren van performance-, ontwikkel- en beoordelingsgesprekken.    Stellen van duidelijke doelstellingen en sturen op KPI's, kwaliteit, servicelevels en klanttevredenheid.    Identificeren van knelpunten en initiëren van structurele procesverbeteringen.    Verantwoordelijk zijn voor de verdere professionalisering van Customer Service.    Verbeteren van de totale customer experience en vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete verbeterinitiatieven.    Nauw samenwerken met het Customer Experience en Transformation team om verbeteringen en veranderingen te realiseren.    Samenwerken met onder andere Operations, Planning, Sales en andere interne stakeholders.    Het team meenemen in veranderingen en zorgen voor draagvlak en eigenaarschap.    Analyseren van prestaties en trends en deze vertalen naar concrete verbeteracties.    Zorgen voor een professionele, klantgerichte en resultaatgerichte werkomgeving.     Wat breng je mee?   Voor deze positie zoeken we een ervaren leidinggevende die gewend is om te opereren in een dynamische en complexe omgeving.  Je brengt bij voorkeur het volgende mee:    Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding.    Meerdere jaren leidinggevende ervaring binnen Customer Service, Customer Operations of een vergelijkbare omgeving.    Ervaring met het direct aansturen en ontwikkelen van medewerkers.    Ervaring binnen een dynamische, operationele omgeving waarin snel geschakeld moet worden.    Een sterke focus op klantgerichtheid en het verbeteren van de customer experience.    Ervaring met performance management, KPI's en procesverbetering.    Sterke communicatieve en coachende vaardigheden.    Het vermogen om verschillende stakeholders met elkaar te verbinden en verandering daadwerkelijk te realiseren.    Een analytische en resultaatgerichte manier van werken.     Wat wordt geboden?     Een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke managementpositie.    Een salaris tussen €80

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Let's skip the part where we pretend this is a normal job ad.     We're Excellence IT, a Melbourne MSP with offices in Scoresby and Sydney. We're growing. Acquisitions and expansion are both on the whiteboard, and our targets are, frankly, a bit ambitious. We like it that way.     AI and automation are already part of how we run. Not as a buzzword. It's live, it's working, and it's only getting started.     We need a Service Delivery Manager to join our leadership team and help build what comes next.      Who you are   You've been running service delivery for 10+ years. You've seen the good, the bad and the 4:55pm Friday Emergency. Not much rattles you anymore.     You know the Kaseya stack properly. Autotask, Datto RMM and IT Glue aren't tools you've "had exposure to." You've built the workflows, fixed them when they broke, and made them earn their keep.     You lead people well. You'll take a team of five (and growing) and make them better than they think they are.     And somewhere along the way, you started thinking: I'd like to build something that's partly mine.      What you'll do    Own service delivery. All of it. Managed services, projects, the 8am chaos  Hit SLAs without breaking a sweat, then kill the root cause so it never comes back  Lead a team of five. Make them better. Make it ten  Keep the queue clean. Aged tickets don't age on your watch  Run Autotask, Datto RMM and IT Glue with an AI layer already working behind the scenes. Your job is to make it smarter, not start from scratch  Know your numbers cold. We run on EOS and TruPeer, and you'll bring the scorecard to the table  Sit on the leadership team and help decide where this thing goes next       How we work   We put people first. Our team, our clients, and the lives we all have outside the business day.     We care about outcomes, not activity. Nobody here is impressed by a busy calendar.     We're growth oriented. That goes for the business and for you.     We're accountable. When something goes sideways, we own it, fix it and move on.     And we win as a team. No lone heroes, no "not my job."     If that sounds like common sense to you, good. You'll fit right in.      The honest bit   We're a small business. We'll pay you fairly, but let's be real: probably a little less than the big end of town would. What we offer instead is what they can't. A genuine seat at the table, and a pathway to real ownership for the right person. Skin in the game. We'll talk details over coffee.      The fine print   This role is based in our Scoresby office. Our leaders are in the room.     We also know life happens. Kids, parents, partners, pets, the half marathon you're training for. We're genuinely understanding about everything that matters outside work.     The right person is everything to us. If that's you, you probably already know.     Send your CV and a few lines on what you'd build here. No essay required.

title: Specialist, Client Experience & Enablement
description: About Flipp   Flipp partners with the largest North American retailers and brands to deliver local promotions and savings to millions of engaged shoppers daily, driving superior returns on investments.  We help people make smarter shopping decisions with autonomy and accountability. With rising living costs, Flipp's mission is crucial. Our Shopper Consideration Platform allows retailers and manufacturers to create digital experiences from their savings & deals content, aiding shoppers in deciding what to buy and where to buy it. Together, we make a difference.  In 2024, Flipp joined forces with the European company Shopfully, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.  Our five principles, Progress Over Perfection, Clarity Through Transparency, Learn Loudly, Challenge with Empathy, and Always Build Better, bring a relentless progress mindset to life. They're not just slogans, but they're the behaviours we expect, reward, and hold ourselves accountable to. You'll be equipped to make an impact, realize your potential, and stay inspired every step of the way.  The Specialist, Client Experience & Enablement (CXE) is a highly autonomous, consultative account management, and technical execution role responsible for safeguarding Flipp's premier revenue engines, expanding its global market, and actively driving product monetization. Operating within a specialized, dual-track pod structure, the Specialist owns the strategic health, technical execution, and operational performance of either a high-revenue Core enterprise portfolio, or a high-velocity Longtail & Onboarding portfolio.   What you'll get the opportunity to do:    Enterprise Portfolio Optimization & Revenue Safeguarding      Multi-Banner Portfolio Architecture:  Manage complex parent-subsidiary corporate structures (e.g., major national accounts encompassing 1–20+ distinct retail banners). Maintain flawless subject-matter expertise across varying banner rules, distinct weekly content cycles, and unique regional consumer behaviours.   SLA Acceleration & Process Optimization:  Proactively re-engineer internal and external workflows to expedite standard 5-day domestic lead times down to a hyper-efficient 1-to-4-day turnaround, enhancing platform agility for enterprise clients.   Beta Product & Innovation Testing Deployment:  Serve as the primary technical deployment partner for high-value clients pioneering new product features, and beta tests. Architect, configure, and validate highly customized, manual system setups to ensure flawless execution of non-standard client experiments.   Value Creation:  Protect and grow accounts generating the top ~80% of corporate revenue through proactive risk identification, intense quality assurance, and aggressive optimization of high-volume weekly content lifecycles.

title: Customer Success Executive
description: Customer Success Executive     Dublin Area, Ireland    €30K-€45K + Benefits       Are you a customer-focused professional who enjoys building relationships, spotting commercial opportunities, and making sure customers receive an excellent experience?  We’re looking for a  Customer Success Executive  to join a growing team and play a key role across customer success, account management, sales support and business development.     The Role  You’ll be responsible for building strong customer relationships, supporting retention and renewals, and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.  You’ll also have a commercial focus, helping to develop new business opportunities through outbound activity, referrals, networking and proactive customer engagement.  Key responsibilities include:  • Building and maintaining positive customer relationships  • Acting as a key point of contact for customer enquiries and support  • Managing customer engagement, retention and renewal activities  • Identifying opportunities for account growth, upgrades and additional services  • Following up quotations, proposals and sales opportunities  • Developing new business through prospecting, outbound calls, email campaigns, referrals and networking  • Maintaining accurate CRM records and managing the sales pipeline  • Processing and managing customer orders through to completion  • Liaising with internal teams to ensure customer requirements are delivered  • Resolving issues quickly and professionally  • Preparing quotations and customer documentation  • Supporting wider sales, customer and operational activities     About You  We’re looking for someone with  1–3 years’ experience  in a role such as:  Customer Success | Account Management | Sales | Business Development | Sales Support | Commercial Administration  Experience within a  SaaS, software, technology or subscription-based environment , particularly where CRM systems are used, would be highly beneficial.     You’ll also bring:  ✔️ Excellent written and spoken English  ✔️ Strong communication and interpersonal skills  ✔️ Excellent organisation and administration skills  ✔️ The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines  ✔️ Confidence communicating with customers by phone, email and in person  ✔️ Good Microsoft Office skills  ✔️ A proactive, professional and customer-focused approach     Why This Role?  This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their career across  customer success, account management and commercial growth , with the chance to make a genuine impact on customer relationships and business performance.  📩  Interested? Apply now or get in touch to find out more.   callum.payne@crossleyscott.com

title: Director of Customer Success
description: We're transforming the grocery industry   At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.  Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.   Instacart is a Flex First team    There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. This is a roll-up-your-sleeves leadership opportunity for someone who has personally led the transformation of CS from reactive enablement toward proactive business advisory, can hire and develop senior consultative talent, and thrives in a fast-paced, BD-led commercial environment with shared standards rather than rigid process. description: GRIDSZ BV.    is een SAAS-Bedrijf met een gespecialiseerd platform voor eigenaren en beheerders van telecom- en glasvezelnetwerken. Het is opgezet als een modulair, cloud‑based SaaS‑platform: je neemt alleen de modules af die je nodig hebt (bijvoorbeeld build, availability, orders, service).  GRIDSZ is ontstaan uit een samenwerking/joint venture van Speer IT (bekend van Cocon Fiber) en softwarebedrijf Infodation, die samen veel ervaring hebben in telco‑software. Implementatietrajecten betekenen dat jij klanten succesvol op GRIDSZ aansluit. Je analyseert processen, maakt strakke implementatieplannen, begeleidt configuraties, verzorgt trainingen en loodst de klant soepel door de adoptiecurve.  Deze positie zit in het Operations-team en rapporteert aan de COO.      Missie:   De Implementation Manager is verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol implementeren van GRIDSZ bij klanten, zodat zij maximale waarde halen uit het platform. Dit door inzet vanaf de eerste kennismaking tot en met een geslaagde livegang. Hij/zij zorgt voor een soepele onboarding, begeleidt de transitie naar nieuwe werkwijzen en fungeert als brug tussen klant, support, sales en development.      KPI’s:   Als Implementation Manager ben jij de spil die klantbehoeften en complexe processen feilloos vertaalt naar de optimale inrichting binnen het GIRDSZ platform. In de executiefase stuur je moeiteloos meerdere parallelle implementaties aan.   100% Implementaties binnen scope en tijd.  Klanttevredenheidsscore na implementatie ≥8/10.  100% Implementaties met volledige overdracht naar support       Succes:   Klanten worden binnen scope, tijd en budget succesvol geïmplementeerd.  Overdracht naar beheer en ondersteuning verloopt vlekkeloos, bijvoorbeeld documentatie, contact en relatie overdracht.     De implementatie legt de basis voor een uitstekende referentie, GRIDSZ staat bekend als een betrouwbare, deskundige en klantgerichte partner en vendor.  Klanten krijgen een realistische indruk van de waarde van GRIDSZ. Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing quality engineer to own the quality and reliability of the Gravis hardware package that turns regular excavators into awesome, autonomous machines. You will work with our engineering and production team in Zurich defining and implementing quality measures like incoming inspections, supply chain validations, failure analysis and product return teardowns to enable our custom AI hardware a safe and reliable operation of heavy machines. You are capable of working both independently and with others, and are intrinsically driven to solve challenging applied problems with a rigorous attention to detail and an exploratory imagination.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Design for Cost & Product Improvement
description:
As Mechanical Engineer, within Distalmotion’s Instruments – Product Improvement team, you will be responsible for driving product optimization initiatives with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, manufacturing efficiency, and continuous product improvement for the Instruments of the surgical system.

The Mechanical Engineer brings solid experience in component and tooling design with associated impact analysis (impact on design verification, risk assessment, quality and manufacturing costs) and root cause investigation of clinical complaints and/or non-conformities.

Tasks:

Design & Cost Optimization

• Specify design, prototype, and implement mechanical components and custom tooling/fixtures with a strong focus on Design for Manufacturing, Assembly and Cost (DFM/DFA/DFC).

• Identify, justify and execute cost reduction opportunities on existing instruments without compromising performance, quality or safety.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders from manufacturing of prototypes to testing and industrialization of the products.

Impact analysis

• Perform comprehensive impact analysis of the proposed design changes, evaluating effects on manufacturing processes, unit costs, risk management and design verification.

• Evaluate financial impact of proposed design changes, including tooling/fixture investments, scrap reduction and cycle time improvement.

• Define technical requirements and test protocols and ensure traceability with the design in test reports. Supervise and participate to design verification.

• Collaborate with internal teams (Ops, QA, RA).

• The compliance with the applicable laws and standards and the design control practices is a must (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820, MDR).

Continuous Improvement

• Investigate clinical complaints and production non-conformity.

title: Director Business and Digital Product Development (m/w/d): win business and drive platform building
description:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e. g. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Roland Berger. We are scaling our go-to-market and need a leader who wins new business for our Vicos and makes sure our platform does what Vico Leads need.

Öffentlicher Sektor? Klingt das nicht nach Bürokratie?

Wir haben noch keine People & Culture Funktion. Du würdest sie aufbauen.

title: Founding Product Manager
description:
Hi, we're Dana and Erik, the founders of Circonomit. We build the decision platform industrial companies use to plan their production.

Dana sees the customer side. She needs to know which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim.

Erik sees the engineering side. He needs requirements that are ready to be built, complete, and clear about what we deliberately leave out.

The product sits between the two, and that is this role. We sell vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt. You decide what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.

How you will be measured: how much of today's project work is standard product a year from now, and how quickly a recognised customer problem becomes a usable capability.

We came out of RWTH research, raised €2.8M with Vorwerk Ventures, and have customers running on our models today. Small team, Cologne office.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. You have owned a product area end to end, not only a backlog.
  • A technical and analytical foundation: engineering, data, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling.
  • You recognise when a requirement creates technical debt or will not be reusable at the next customer. You will not write production code.
  • Experience deciding under incomplete information, and explaining the trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
  • You are comfortable working directly with plant managers and controllers, and understand how they decide today.
  • German at C1 level or above, and fluent English. Customer conversations happen in German.
  • Existing work visa for Germany.

You should enjoy being in front of customers in your first week, and deciding without a rese

title: Customer Service Manager
description: Description du poste    We’re looking for an experienced and dynamic Customer Service Manager to lead and evolve our customer service operation in France. This is a high-impact leadership role where you’ll shape and deliver the customer service strategy, ensuring a seamless and high-quality experience across the full customer journey. From Inside Sales through to Contracts and Project Management, you’ll drive operational excellence, continuous improvement, and make it easy for customers to do business with us.    In this role, you’ll be responsible for improving customer satisfaction and NPS, delivering against key performance metrics, and embedding a customer-first culture throughout the organisation. You’ll use data, market insights and forecasting to inform business decisions, while also driving improvements in processes, systems and ways of working. Working cross-functionally, you’ll ensure a fast and accurate flow of information and play a key role in supporting wider commercial success.    As a leader, you’ll coach and develop a high-performing team, creating a culture of accountability, engagement and continuous development. Experience within manufacturing or engineering environments would be advantageous, along with the ability to work effectively across cultures within a regional or international business. Our purpose is Keeping the World Flowing for Future Generations.    For over sixty years, the world has relied on us to create the things that keep everything moving. From oil and gas to water and shipping, pharmaceuticals and food- these are the flows on which our modern world depends.    Today we're respected and admired for our people, performance and products. Our success flows from our commitment to engineering excellence, and that's what we will always pursue, safely and sustainably.    Rotork is going through an exciting period of change and growth, building on our existing market success. It's a great time to join us and make an impact in shaping the future of our business.

title: Leder til kundecenter med ansvar for medarbejdere i deres første job
description: Har du erfaring med at lede medarbejdere i et kundecenter? Trives du med at skabe retning, struktur og resultater i en hverdag med højt tempo? Og motiveres du af at udvikle mennesker i deres første job? Så er det dig, vi søger.  I ATP søger vi en leder til vores Serviceteam i Vordingborg. Her får du ansvaret for en sektion med 20-25 medarbejdere, hvor størstedelen er i deres første fuldtidsjob i et sabbatår.  Det er først og fremmest en ledelsesopgave. Du skal sikre den daglige drift, skabe trivsel og udvikling i teamet og sørge for, at både kvalitet, produktivitet og servicemål bliver indfriet.  Du bliver en del af et lederteam på fire sektionschefer, som i fællesskab har ansvaret for omkring 100-140 medarbejdere. Sammen sikrer I, at borgere og samarbejdspartnere får en professionel og effektiv service på tværs af de områder, ATP administrerer.   Dine opgaver   Du får ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af en gruppe på 20-25 medarbejdere. Konkret skal du:    sætte retning for teamet og sikre, at driftsmål, svartider og kvalitetskrav bliver indfriet   gennem nærværende ledelse coache og udvikle unge medarbejdere, som ofte er i deres første job, så de lykkes med opgaverne og udvikler sig undervejs   skabe engagement, motivation og en arbejdskultur, hvor medarbejderne tager ansvar og hjælper hinanden   følge op på performance, trivsel, fravær og kompetenceudvikling gennem tæt ledelse og løbende sparring   planlægge og prioritere ressourcer, så bemandingen matcher opgavemængden   samarbejde tæt med de øvrige sektionschefer om drift, forbedringer og udvikling af Serviceteamet  navigere i det forretningsmæssige tværgående samarbejde.     Stillingen kræver daglig fysisk tilstedeværelse i Vordingborg.   Hvem er du?    Du er en erfaren personaleleder og gerne fra et kundecenter eller en anden driftsorganisation, hvor ledelse tæt på medarbejderne er afgørende for resultaterne.  Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:    har ledet større medarbejdergrupper og er vant til at skabe resultater gennem andre   har erfaring fra et callcenter, kundecenter eller tilsvarende miljø med højt aktivitetsniveau og tydelige servicemål   er dygtig til at lede unge medarbejdere og skabe rammer, hvor de både præsterer og udvikler sig   arbejder systematisk med opfølgning, feedback og performanceledelse   kan skabe ro, overblik og prioritering, når opgaverne ændrer sig i løbet af dagen   bygger relationer og skaber følgeskab gennem tydelig kommunikation og nærværende ledelse.     Du er uddannet indenfor ledelse og har dokumenteret erfaring med at skabe trivsel, udvikling og resultater gennem dit lederskab.   Hvem er vi?    Serviceteamet håndterer telefoniske henvendelser og løser opgaver på nogle af de ydelser, ATP administrerer. Vi hjælper blandt andet borgere med spørgsmål om barsel, boligstøtte, begravelseshjælp m.m.  Mere end 90 % af medarbejderne i afdelingen er i sabbatår. Det giver en energisk hverdag, hvor ledelse, udvikling og motivation spiller en afgørende roll

title: Key Account Manager Sweden
description: At Aidon, we develop state-of-the-art technology and services for energy metering and distribution. Our customers are Nordic energy distribution companies. Through our solutions and the way we act, we promote the development of efficient, low-emission energy systems and the responsible use of natural resources. The energy industry is rapidly evolving, and the demand for smart solutions—and smart people to create them—is high. Why not seize the opportunity today?    We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven  Key Account Manager  to join our international Commercial team. This role combines responsibilities in sales and client relationship management. You will drive sales growth in Sweden and serve as the primary point of contact for potential and assigned clients, ensuring their satisfaction and identify new business opportunities. Additionally, you will oversee of key projects together with our Customer Success team.   Main Responsibilities     Identify and engage with key decision-makers within DSOs to promote our technical solutions.  Identify new sales opportunities within existing accounts and develop account strategies aligned with customer needs, regulatory developments, and market trends.  Work together with the regional commercial team to develop proposals and negotiate contracts.  Collaborate with internal teams (sales, solutions, operations) both locally and globally to ensure successful solution implementation. What We Expect From You     5+ years of experience in sales or client management.  Proven track record of growing client accounts.  Experience in key account management, preferably in energy, utilities, or technology solutions.  Knowledge in smart metering systems, AMI/AMR technologies, or related digital infrastructure.  Experience with additional smart grid technologies such as monitoring and control systems, SCADA, DMS and RTUs is an advantage. title: Key Account Manager
description: VIL OG KAN DU UDVIKLE STÆRKE KUNDERELATIONER OG DRIVE KOMMERCIEL VÆKST FOR EVA TRIO & EVA SOLO?       OM EVA TRIO   Eva Trio er en dansk designvirksomhed bag to stærke brands: Eva Trio og Eva Solo. Vi udvikler og markedsfører produkter til køkken, bord og bolig, hvor funktionalitet, æstetik og kvalitet går hånd i hånd. Med afsæt i dansk designtradition og et internationalt udsyn skaber vi produkter, der gør hverdagen smukkere, enklere og mere inspirerende. Vi er midt i en spændende udvikling, hvor stærke partnerskaber og en tydelig digital tilstedeværelse er centrale for vores fortsatte vækst.      DIN ROLLE   Som Key Account Manager får du en central rolle i at udvikle samarbejdet med udvalgte nøglekunder, danske kæder og e-tailers i Skandinavien. Du får ansvar for at drive salget, udvikle kunderne kommercielt og sikre, at Eva Trio og Eva Solo står stærkt på tværs af både fysiske og digitale salgskanaler.     Du refererer til Head of Sales, Scandinavia og bliver en del af en ambitiøs salgsorganisation, hvor samarbejde, professionalisme og eksekvering er afgørende. Rollen kombinerer strategisk kundearbejde med en stærk operationel tilgang, og du vil arbejde tæt sammen med kollegaer på tværs af salg, marketing, supply chain og kundeservice for at skabe resultater og sikre høj kundetilfredshed.     Du trives med en dynamisk hverdag, hvor struktur, forberedelse, klar kommunikation og opfølgning er nøglen til succes. Du arbejder målrettet med kundeudvikling, salgsplanlægning, sortiment, kampagner og performance – og du har blik for både vækstpotentiale, brandpositionering og stærke relationer.      DINE PRIMÆRE ANSVARSOMRÅDER    Udvikle og eksekvere salgs- og kundeplaner for udvalgte nøglekunder, kæder og e-tailers  Drive budget, forecast, opfølgning og løbende markedsrapportering  Gennemføre årsforhandlinger, nyhedspræsentationer og løbende kundemøder  Arbejde strategisk med sortiment, kategorianalyser, kampagneplanlægning og salgsperformance  Identificere vækstmuligheder og omsætte dem til konkrete resultater  Styrke relationer til centrale beslutningstagere og nøglefunktioner hos kunderne  Sikre optimal præsentation af brandene Eva Trio og Eva Solo på kundernes digitale platforme og i fysiske butikker  Anvende salgsdata, digitale værktøjer og markedsindsigter til at skabe målrettede initiativer  Samarbejde tæt med marketing om kampagner, produktmateriale, content og synlighed  Deltage i messer, kundearrangementer og relevante brancheaktiviteter       DIN PROFIL   Du er kommercielt stærk, har flair for at knytte tætte kunderelationer og er målrettet. Du har erfaring med at udvikle kunder og skabe vækst gennem struktur, forberedelse, godt købmandsskab og en professionel tilgang til salgsarbejdet. Du trives med ansvar, arbejder selvstændigt og formår samtidig at skabe gode samarbejder på tværs af organisationen.  Du har naturlig interesse for brands, produkter og forbrugeradfærd, og du forstår værdien af at kombinere stærke kunderelationer me

title: Key Account Manager
description: At Vitec Autosystemer, you will play a key role in our continued growth in Norway. You will be the commercial link between our customers, the Norwegian organization, and our product teams, with a significant opportunity to influence both the business and the development of our solutions.  If you thrive in a role with a high degree of autonomy and want to make a real impact in a company where your ideas can be turned into reality, this is an exciting opportunity.      About the role   As Key Account Manager, you will take commercial ownership of our established customer base of independent workshops, workshop chains, and parts wholesalers across Norway. Your main focus will be to ensure that these customers derive lasting value from our solutions. This is not a traditional new-business role: new deals are welcome when they arise, but they are not the only focus.     You will hold the only commercial role in the Norwegian organization, giving you a high degree of freedom and responsibility, as well as a real opportunity to influence how the business develops. You will work closely with skilled colleagues in support, product development, and delivery, and your line manager is based in Finland.      Examples of responsibilities    Manage and develop an established customer portfolio in Norway  Lead customer meetings, product demonstrations, and workshops  Drive renewals, upselling activities, and customer satisfaction  Identify customer needs and translate them into business opportunities  Contribute market and customer insights to product development  Provide customer and commercial perspectives to guide the adaptation and development of our solutions for the Norwegian market       Who are you?   We believe you enjoy combining commercial thinking with relationship building. You are self-driven, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of your work. At the same time, you are curious about your customers' business and motivated by creating long-term value rather than pursuing short-term wins.      To succeed in this role, we would like you to have:    Experience managing and developing existing customer relationships  A background in B2B sales to small or medium-sized businesses  Experience selling software, SaaS, ERP solutions, or other business-critical systems  The ability to conduct customer presentations and needs analyses independently  A structured way of working and experience managing a large customer portfolio  Fluency in Norwegian, both spoken and written, and a good command of English       It is an advantage if you have experience in:    The automotive industry or aftermarket sector  Wholesale or distribution businesses  Business management systems or workshop management solutions  Product development or gathering customer requirements       Why Vitec Autosystemer AS? Du vil arbeide i skjæringspunktet mellom kunde, teknologi og kundeleveranser, følge opp tekniske problemstillinger og bidra til at leveransene møter kundens behov. Du sørger for at erfaringer og forbedringsmuligheter blir fanget opp og fulgt videre i organisasjonen – fra behov og avklaring til leveranse og videreutvikling.  Advanced Solutions er en del av KONGSBERG, og du vil bli en del av et høykompetent teknologimiljø med tett samarbeid på tvers av fagområder og organisasjonen.   Viktige arbeidsoppgaver     Ansvar for en kundeportefølje med tett teknisk og operativ oppfølging gjennom hele systemets levetid, inkludert utvikling og vedlikehold av langsiktige kunderelasjoner.  Kartlegge og analysere kundens tekniske og operative behov, og omsette disse til konkrete forbedringsforslag, nye muligheter og gjennomførbare løsninger.  Lede og koordinere tekniske avklaringer og bidra til effektiv samhandling mellom kunder og relevante fagmiljøer.  Samarbeide tett med engineering, program og prosjektorganisasjonen for å sikre helhetlige leveranser og god kundeoppfølging.  Bidra til videreutvikling av eksisterende løsninger og tjenester, samt identifisere nye anvendelser og forretningsmuligheter i dialog med nasjonale og internasjonale kunder. We are looking for a Team Leader for Customer Care (Overseas) to lead a team of skilled Logistics Coordinators handling global order-to-delivery processes. This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership with hands-on operational responsibility in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.  “ You will take on a key role leading a skilled Customer Care team, balancing daily operations with people development while collaborating across the business to deliver excellent service to our global customers ,” says Hiring Manager, Lasse Tarnok Larsen.   How You Will Make An Impact   This role is part of Customer Care within the Commercial business area, where you will lead a team of Logistic Coordinators responsible for managing order-to-delivery processes and customer communication for overseas markets.  You will balance operational execution with people leadership, ensuring high service quality while developing your team and driving continuous improvements. You will play a key role in coordinating across Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and external partners to deliver strong customer outcomes.  Your main responsibility will include    Leading, coach, and develop a team of Logistics Coordinators, ensuring engagement and performance  Managing and prioritizing daily operations, including handling escalations and complex customer cases  Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external logistics partners to ensure timely and efficient deliveries  Drive continuous improvements in processes, data quality, and ways of working  Take an active role in daily operations through responsibility of selected customers     What Will Make You Successful   To succeed in this role, you combine a strong operational foundation with the motivation to grow as a leader in a complex and fast-paced environment. You have hands-on experience within international logistics, particularly sea freight and air freight operations, supply chain, or customer service, and you understand the dynamics of global order-to-delivery processes and cross-functional collaboration. You are comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and know how to balance operational priorities with long-term improvements. Ideally, you bring a few years of relevant experience and are ready to take the next step in your leadership journey.  We hope that you will bring    Experience within international logistics, particularly sea freight and air freight operations supply chain, or customer service, ideally linked to order-to-delivery processes  Solid stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate across functions  A clear and engaging leadership approach that builds trust and develops others  Strong prioritisation and decision-making skills in a fast-paced environment  A collaborative and relationship-driven mindset, working effectively with both internal and external

title: Market Manager
description: Position Description   Imagine Tomorrow with Us |   Ata whakaarohia tō āpōpō   At Fonterra Te Mātāpuna, we want everyone to feel they can be themselves.  Whether you're early in your career or ready for your next step, Fonterra offers a unique opportunity to grow with a global dairy co-operative that values care, collaboration, and contribution.  Owned by New Zealand dairy farmers and supported by a dedicated team, we are all working together to create a better future. Imagine tomorrow with us, where your career can grow, and you can create positive change.   About us | He kupu mō mātou    The GSC Customer team plays a critical role in connecting our customers, markets and operations. Working across Planning, Logistics, Manufacturing and Commercial teams, we help ensure the voice of the customer is represented in decision-making while driving strong supply chain performance and customer outcomes. The Market Manager team acts as a key connector between our markets and the wider Co-op, helping deliver a seamless customer experience.   About the Opportunity | Mō tēnei tūranga    We have an exciting opportunity for a Market Manager to join our GSC Customer team on a 12-month fixed-term basis.  As the voice of the customer across Global Supply Chain, you'll be responsible for building strong relationships across a diverse portfolio of markets. You'll work closely with market teams and operational stakeholders to understand customer needs, advocate for market priorities and support strong customer and supply chain outcomes.  This role offers a unique opportunity to engage with a broad range of customers, cultures and supply chain challenges. You'll partner across Planning, Logistics, Manufacturing and Commercial teams to drive alignment, manage issues proactively and identify opportunities to continuously improve the customer experience.   Key Responsibilities Include     Championing customer advocacy across Global Supply Chain.   Building trusted relationships with market and customer stakeholders across multiple regions.   Leading market engagement, feedback discussions and regular governance forums.   Driving improvements in order book health, customer experience and DIFOT performance.   Supporting the resolution of supply chain issues and critical incidents.   Identifying opportunities for operational improvement and enhanced customer outcomes.   Providing market insights that influence customer-centric business decisions.      About You | Mōu    You'll be an experienced relationship builder with the ability to work effectively across diverse stakeholder groups and complex environments.  You may come from a supply chain, customer operations, logistics, planning or commercial background and will enjoy partnering across teams to influence outcomes and deliver value for customers.   You'll Also Bring     Experience in customer-facing, market-facing or supply chain roles.   Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing capability.   Excelle

title: Customer Experience Manager
description: Il cliente è un’importante realtà operante nel settore  healthcare  , alla ricerca di una figura di  Customer Experience Manager   da inserire all'interno di una funzione strategica dedicata allo sviluppo e al miglioramento dell'esperienza di clienti e stakeholder.  La persona selezionata contribuirà alla definizione e all'implementazione della strategia di  Customer Experience  , con l'obiettivo di garantire un'esperienza coerente, efficace e distintiva lungo tutti i punti di contatto con gli stakeholder.  Contribuirà inoltre allo sviluppo di servizi, processi e modelli di interazione che rafforzino il posizionamento dell’azienda come partner capace di generare valore attraverso la qualità dell'esperienza offerta agli stakeholder.  Il ruolo prevede una collaborazione costante con funzioni aziendali trasversali (Marketing Strategico, Business Unit, Market Access, etc.) per promuovere una cultura orientata all'ascolto, alla customer centricity e al miglioramento continuo.   Responsibilities     Mappare, sviluppare e aggiornare i customer journey delle diverse linee di business e dei differenti stakeholder.   Analizzare i momenti di interazione chiave, identificando opportunità di ottimizzazione dell'esperienza e di creazione di valore.   Definire standard e linee guida di Customer Experience, supportandone l'adozione nei vari touchpoint.   Collaborare alla raccolta della Voice of Customer e delle evidenze provenienti dagli stakeholder.   Raccogliere, analizzare e interpretare insight qualitativi e quantitativi provenienti da clienti, stakeholder e funzioni interne.   Tradurre i dati raccolti in raccomandazioni e azioni concrete per l'evoluzione di processi, servizi e modalità di engagement.   Collaborare con team Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Operations, Customer Service e altre funzioni aziendali.   Supportare lo sviluppo di iniziative omnicanale finalizzate a migliorare coinvolgimento, soddisfazione e continuità dell'esperienza.   Coordinare progetti cross-funzionali orientati all'ottimizzazione dei processi e dell'esperienza degli stakeholder.   Definire e monitorare KPI di Customer Experience e proporre azioni correttive e di miglioramento.   Diffondere una cultura aziendale orientata alla customer centricity attraverso attività di sensibilizzazione e consulenza interna     Your Profile    Requisiti Richiesti:     Laurea in discipline economiche, marketing, scientifiche o affini.   Esperienza di almeno 5 anni in ruoli di Customer Experience, Customer Engagement o Marketing.   Conoscenza delle metodologie di customer journey mapping e customer analysis.   Capacità di analisi dei dati e interpretazione degli insight.   Esperienza nella gestione di progetti trasversali.   Capacità di collaborazione con team multidisciplinari.   Eccellenti competenze comunicative, relazionali e di ascolto.   Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.      Costituiscono un plus     Esperienza maturata in contesti healthcare, farmaceutici o medical devi

title: Aero Alliance Customer Fulfillment and Experience Leader
description: Job Description Summary   Do you want to drive world-class service excellence and transform how we deliver value to our customers in a global energy environment?  GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Aero Alliance Customer Fulfilment and Experience Leader to join our Gas Power team based in Avenza (Carrara).   Job Description    GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World   With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.  Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.   Power  Our Power portfolio provides sustainable, more efficient energy solutions. With expertise across Gas, Hydro, Nuclear, and Steam Power, we help customers deliver electricity to homes, industries, and communities worldwide.   Let’s Talk About The Role   The Aero Alliance Customer Fulfilment and Experience Leader will champion the customer journey, ensuring total satisfaction through superior quality, timely delivery, and cost-efficiency across the entire engine overhauling lifecycle.  You will act as the primary bridge between our shop floor operations and our customers, responding to customer needs, monitoring all the engines maintenance steps and ensuring that every touchpoint reflects our commitment to professionalism, transparency, and reliability. By leading cross-functional efforts and implementing standardized service processes, you will ensure our Avenza Service Center delivers a predictable and exceptional experience, turning our customers into long-term partners.   How You Will Make a Difference     Leading the end-to-end customer experience, from initial engine induction through to final testing, ensuring a seamless and high-quality service journey.  Driving cross-functional collaboration to optimize shop slot utilization and ensure all maintenance activities align with contractual requirements and customer deadlines.  Creating standardized, professional communication decks and reporting frameworks that provide customers with clear, data-driven updates throughout the maintenance process.  Improving service delivery by analyzing customer feedback and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to enhance satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.  Building a customer-centric culture within the Avenza facility by training staff on best practices and fostering a proactive, service-oriented mindset across all shop functions.  Managing the end-to-end customer site visit experience, serving as the single point of contact to ensure professional and impactful engagements.     Skills For Success

title: Responsable CRM & Fidélisation H/F
description: Notre client est une entreprise française à taille humaine, en forte croissance, évoluant dans un univers premium et disposant d'une activité e-commerce à dimension internationale.  La société connaît actuellement une phase importante de développement et de structuration de ses activités digitales. Elle souhaite notamment renforcer l'exploitation de sa donnée clients afin de mieux comprendre les comportements d'achat, développer la fidélisation et soutenir durablement sa croissance.  Son organisation combine agilité, circuits de décision courts et haut niveau d'exigence, avec des équipes habituées à travailler de manière transverse entre digital, marketing, e-commerce et fonctions techniques.  Basées en région Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, les équipes évoluent dans un environnement dynamique où autonomie, prise d'initiative et culture du résultat occupent une place importante, tout en préservant un réel équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.   POSTE / MISSIONS   Rejoignez une entreprise française à taille humaine, en forte croissance, évoluant dans un univers e-commerce premium, et contribuez à une nouvelle étape dans la structuration de sa stratégie CRM et fidélisation.  Dans un contexte de développement soutenu, l'entreprise souhaite aujourd'hui exploiter plus finement la richesse de sa donnée clients et prospects pour renforcer la conversion, le réachat et la fidélisation.   L'enjeu :  transformer une base déjà importante et une infrastructure CRM existante en véritables leviers de croissance et de connaissance client.  Rattaché(e) à la Direction Digitale, vous prenez en main le pilotage de la stratégie CRM & Fidélisation autour de trois enjeux majeurs : exploiter la donnée pour identifier les opportunités business, développer une stratégie lifecycle performante et faire évoluer le programme de fidélité.  Vous intervenez à la fois sur la réflexion stratégique, l'analyse de la performance et la mise en œuvre opérationnelle des actions permettant d'accroître la valeur de la base clients et prospects.   Vos Responsabilités Principales      Analyser et segmenter la base clients et prospects afin d'identifier les populations à fort potentiel et construire une feuille de route d'activations priorisée selon leur impact business.   Définir et piloter les principaux KPI CRM : conversion, réactivation, churn, valeur client, réachat, rentabilité des activations et chiffre d'affaires généré.   Concevoir, déployer et optimiser les scénarios lifecycle : welcome, post-achat, abandon, réactivation, win-back, VIP et autres parcours automatisés.   Développer une démarche permanente de test & learn, notamment à travers des tests A/B, afin d'améliorer la performance des campagnes et parcours.   Piloter et faire évoluer le programme de fidélité, ses mécaniques d'animation et sa contribution à la fréquence et à la valeur d'achat. title: CRM Manager - Nordics
description: About Us   SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world.  Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja , the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.   AI at SharkNinja    At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in. title: CRM Manager - RODD & GUNN Global
description: CRM Manager - Rodd & Gunn Global   Rodd & Gunn is a lifestyle menswear brand that is quickly expanding around the globe and our customers don't just transact, they build an emotional connection with the brand they love that keeps them coming back season after season. We're looking for a CRM Manager to make that happen more often, in more markets, for more customers.     You'll own how we talk to customers after the first purchase: the global lifecycle strategy, the growth of our loyalty programme, and the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform behind it, across New Zealand, Australia, the US, Canada, the UK and Europe.     It's a genuinely hybrid role. You'll set the strategy and the commercial targets, and you'll be hands on in Journey Builder when a journey needs fixing in a business that never sleeps and report directly to the Executive GM Global Ecommerce and Digital. This is a rare opportunity to work for a local NZ retailer with a global footprint.      What you'll do    Build always on lifecycle programmes, from welcome to win-back, that reward loyalty rather than rely on discounting  Grow loyalty enrolment, engagement and repeat purchase  Sharpen segmentation and personalisation across markets and languages  Own Marketing Cloud end to end: journeys, automations, data quality, consent and deliverability  Lead and develop a small CRM team       What you'll bring    5+ years in CRM, lifecycle marketing or marketing automation  Deep, practical SFMC experience (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder)  Working SQL, AMPscript and HTML/CSS  A commercial mindset: you can connect a journey change to a revenue outcome and explain it clearly  Meticulous attention to detail. You don't press send until it's right.      Loyalty programme, multi-market or premium retail experience is a bonus.  If you want to shape how a premium global brand builds lasting customer relationships, we'd love to hear from you.     📍 Auckland Central Location  #CRM #SalesforceMarketingCloud #LifecycleMarketing #Loyalty #RetailCareers #Hiring

title: MMBERS Loyalty Manager
description: C omo  MMBERS Loyalty Manager  formarás parte del departamento de Marketing Digital y trabajarás estrechamente con la responsable del equipo.      Serás responsable de evolucionar el actual programa de loyalty MMBRS hacia una comunidad viva, relevante y reconocible para la Generación Z. Junto con el departamento de Marketing, definirás y coordinarás la activación de MMBRS Community para convertir el conocimiento de la audiencia en experiencias, contenidos y comunicaciones que generen conexión, participación y recurrencia.      MMBRS Community se construye alrededor de territorios que forman parte de la vida de sus miembros: experiencias, música, circularidad y moda, además de nuevas formas de consumir vinculadas a sus intereses. El reto será convertirlos en propuestas coherentes y atractivas, con distintos niveles de participación y en un entorno internacional con presencia de Bershka MMBERS en 17 Países.      ¿Cuáles serían tus funciones?      Mantenimiento de la comunidad y su comunicación:   Definir y desarrollar la propuesta de comunidad: qué ofrece MMBRS dentro de sus territorios, qué papel tiene Bershka y cómo se conectan entre sí los distintos territorios e iniciativas.  Diseñar y coordinar el plan de comunicación de MMBRS, construyendo una narrativa clara y consistente, y desarrollando campañas y contenidos que capten la atención, generen conversación y animen a participar.  Crear valor para los miembros mediante una propuesta que combine reconocimiento, acceso, experiencias y beneficios, conectando la participación con el programa de loyalty.  Entender y representar a la Generación Z: seguir sus códigos, intereses, referentes, hábitos culturales y cambios de comportamiento, y transformar ese conocimiento en propuestas actuales y relevantes.  Calendarizar y activar experiencias globales y locales para distintos niveles de participación, desde grandes experiencias hasta iniciativas frecuentes y cercanas, alineadas con los objetivos de marca, comunidad y negocio.   Colaboradores y coordinación transversal:   Identificar, desarrollar y gestionar partnerships con los colaboradores de ámbitos como música, experiencias, circularidad, cultura, lifestyle y entretenimiento, acordando objetivos, condiciones y entregables.  Coordinar a los equipos involucrados —Marketing, Branding, eCommerce, CRM, Contenidos, mercados y otras áreas internas— y a los partners externos, ordenando prioridades, timings y presupuestos para llevar las iniciativas de la idea a la ejecución.  Hacer seguimiento de la participación, el uso de beneficios, la respuesta a las comunicaciones, la recurrencia y la percepción de la comunidad, junto con los principales indicadores de engagement, loyalty y retorno.  Extraer aprendizajes y convertirlos en decisiones que mejoren las siguientes activaciones y la evolución de MMBRS Community.       ¿Cómo te imaginamos? Analytisches Verständnis sowie hohe Zahlenaffinität.   Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.   Kommunikationsstärke und Serviceorientierung.   Hohe Genauigkeit und Verlässlichkeit.   Teamfähigkeit sowie bereichsübergreifendes Denken. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Descriptif du poste  Nos clients nous confient une part importante de leur patrimoine. Ils attendent un niveau de service de banque privée. title: Global Customer Platform Manager (f/m/x)
description: Shape how Blum wins and grows with its most important global customers.   Serving our most important global customers involves almost every part of Blum, from sales and product development to manufacturing, supply chain and senior leadership. Success means acting as one organisation. Our Global Customer Platform makes this possible. It is a network of teams, processes, decision making and initiatives that turns customer priorities into action across Blum.  As Global Customer Platform Manager, you will lead this platform and become the go-to partner for advancing the global customer agenda. Working closely with the Global Key Account Manager, you will make sure that what the customer says externally is implemented internally at Blum.   YOU WILL      shape the Global Customer Platform: define how Blum organises, collaborates and makes decisions around its most important global customers  embed customer priorities in core processes, from product development to our global manufacturing and supply network  drive decisions at senior level: bring the right topics to senior management and turn them into clear decisions and action  mobilise stakeholders across Blum: bring sales, marketing, product, manufacturing, distribution and supply chain together around shared priorities  turn complexity into action: structure complex topics, clarify priorities and drive cross-functional initiatives forward      WE     are seeking an individual with experience: around 10 years in an international industrial or B2B environment, ideally in key account management, corporate development, consulting or programme management  value strategic thinking: you see the bigger picture and translate customer priorities into clear actions for the wider business  welcome candidates who can influence without authority: you build trusted relationships, bring senior stakeholders together and move complex topics forward  prize effective communication skills: you present confidently and persuasively, from operational experts to the Executive Board  are offering a position that requires cross-functional leadership: you have led initiatives or programmes across organisational boundaries in a global setup  attach importance to a good education: you will have a degree in business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience  operate globally: fluent business English is required and German language skills are nice to have      WHY WORK ORANGE? title: Care Ecosystem Activation Manager

Activation Leadにレポートし、プロダクトマネージャー、メディカル、営業と連携します。多職種・複数施設間の協働を促し、病院内のチームと退院後のケアを担う関係者との連携を支援します。  担当エリアおよび戦略アカウントにおける活動の進捗と成果に責任を持ちます。施設ごとの課題や治療上のギャップを分析し、関係者とアクションプランを策定・実行します。また、KPIに基づいて成果を評価し、改善につなげるための市場インサイトや導入時の学びを共有します。 課題分析と実行計画の策定：施設ごとの課題や、治療・診療プロセス上のギャップを分析し、ケアエコシステム導入の障壁を特定します。関係者と実行可能な対応策を立案し、実行します。  部門横断の計画立案：プロダクトマネージャー、メディカル、営業と連携し、エリア計画と戦略アカウント計画の一貫性を保ちます。KPIを用いて進捗を評価し、必要に応じて計画を見直します。    市場インサイトとベストプラクティスの開発 必要に応じて部門横断プロジェクトに参加し、ケアエコシステムの構築・活用に関する知見、スキル、経験を活かして貢献します。    求める人物像  求める経験・資質  応募資格    学士号を有する方。   製薬会社において、MRやマーケティングなどを通じたKOLマネジメントの経験が7年以上ある方。   論理的に考え、仮説を活用し、不確実な状況や変化の中でも柔軟に行動できる方。 title: Senior Customer Value Manager
description: About Nextail      Mission    Nextail exists to bring state-of-the-art technology and practices to fashion retail operations.    Vision    To become the go-to merchandising tool for fashion retailers, so they're more profitable, shoppers get a better experience, and the planet is harmed less.     Who are we     We're a 12-year-old Spanish scale-up with a startup mentality, building advanced AI/ML technology for the fashion retail industry. Born in Spain, we've partnered with more than 50 fashion retailers around the world.     About the Role     We're hiring a  Senior Customer Value Manager  to own the full customer lifecycle for a portfolio of retail clients—from onboarding through adoption, value realization, and renewal readiness. The core of this role is what happens after go-live: driving adoption, proving value, and getting accounts renewal-ready — you won't be carrying onboarding alone when an account calls for extra hands.
