description: Brinner du för kundrelationer och vill vara den som gör skillnad i varje kunddialog? Vi på Bilvision söker nu en Customer Success Coordinator som vill bli den centrala länken mellan kund, affär och leverans. En stor del av vardagen handlar om att sitta nära kunden i den dagliga supporten – svara på frågor, lösa ärenden och vara den trygga rösten kunden vänder sig till. Du blir en del av ett tight team där ditt engagemang syns och skapar verkligt värde. Låter det intressant? Läs vidare!       Vi på Bilvision tillhandahåller en webbportal (SaaS) för företag aktiva inom och runt fordonsbranschen, allt ifrån fordonshandlare till försäkring- och finansbolag. Vårt mål är att hjälpa kunder med att digitalisera och effektivisera sina arbetsprocesser i syfte att spara tid och minska fel. Långsiktigt är målet att bli det bästa SaaS-bolaget i Norden inom fordonshandeln!      Om rollen      I rollen som Customer Success Coordinator arbetar du med Customer Success- och Säljteamet för att utveckla och maximera värdet i våra befintliga kundrelationer. Du blir kundens första kontakt och den som förstår kundens behov och omsätter dem i konkreta insatser. Du kommer bland annat att      Ge daglig support och hantera kundärenden - du är kundens första kontakt och ser till att frågor löses snabbt och tryggt  Säkerställa kundvärde genom att proaktivt följa upp och analysera kundernas användning  Bygga och utveckla kundrelationer med fokus på förtroende och långsiktighet  Driva retention och tillväxt genom upsell och cross-sell  Ansvara för onboarding av nya kunder och en smidig uppstart  Koordinera leverans och intern samverkan – rätt åtgärd vid rätt tillfälle  Arbeta datadrivet med analys av användning, KPI:er och resultat för riktade aktiviteter       Vem vi tror att du är      Vi söker dig som är i början av din karriär, har ett service-mindset utöver det vanliga och som drivs av att skapa värde för andra. Du trivs i en roll där service, relationer och affärsförståelse går hand i hand, och det bästa du vet är att hjälpa kunder att lösa sina utmaningar – med en stor portion tålamod och engagemang. För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:      Är relationsskapande och förtroendeingivande  Är proaktiv och lösningsorienterad  Är strukturerad och tar ägarskap för dina kunder och leveranser  Har en stark kommunikativ förmåga och anpassar dig efter mottagaren  Har god affärsförståelse och ser kundvärde  Behärskar svenska flytande och har goda kunskaper i engelska      Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Service och/eller Customer Success, ett datadrivet arbetssätt (analys av användning, KPI:er och resultat) samt erfarenhet av SaaS-, tech- eller datadrivna tjänster.      Vilka vi är      Bilvision är ett framåtsträvande specialistbolag som utvecklar ledande informationstjänster för den svenska fordonsbranschen. Vi gör vardagen smidigare och smartare för våra kunder genom att täcka flera led i deras dagliga verksamhet – från fordonsinformation till uppfö

När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. title: Customer Success | Onboarding Specialist
description: ¡Únete a la revolución de la inteligencia artificial en  Vidext ! 🚀  La comunicación corporativa necesita cambiar porque la forma en que consumimos contenido ya ha cambiado.  Vidext es una scale-up que está transformando cómo las empresas crean, comparten y miden su contenido, mediante una plataforma de comunicación inteligente que empodera a sus equipos con IA.  Ya trabajamos con más de 220 empresas como Iberdrola, Loewe, ISDIN o Mapfre. Ahora buscamos a alguien con ganas de aprender y aportar desde el primer día.  ¿Te apasiona la tecnología, el ambiente startup y quieres desarrollar tu carrera como  Customer Success  con enfoque a Onboardings? ¡Te estamos buscando para unirte a nuestro equipo en Vidext!  🌟  ¿Cuáles serán tus misiones?     Liderar el proceso de Onboarding de nuevos clientes, asegurando una experiencia fluida desde la firma hasta la puesta en marcha.  Guiar y formar a los clientes en el uso de la plataforma/producto, traduciendo procesos complejos en explicaciones claras y adaptadas a cada interlocutor.  Coordinar y gestionar proyectos de implementación, estableciendo cronogramas, prioridades y entregables con múltiples cuentas en paralelo.  Acompañar en la personalización de proyectos, apoyando en diseño, maquetación y configuración para garantizar una solución alineada con la identidad del cliente.  Actuar de forma proactiva, anticipando dudas o necesidades y ofreciendo recomendaciones antes de que surjan problemas.  Mantener una comunicación cercana y profesional con los diferentes stakeholders, reforzando la confianza y la satisfacción desde el inicio de la relación.  Identificar oportunidades de mejora continua en el proceso de onboarding y trasladar feedback al equipo interno (producto, soporte, ventas).    Requisitos:  💼  El perfil que buscamos:     Experiencia previa en Customer Onboarding, Customer Success o Implementation Specialist (idealmente en SaaS o entornos digitales es un plus).  Habilidades de comunicación y formación: capaz de explicar procesos complejos de forma clara y pedagógica.  Capacidad de gestión de proyectos y organización con múltiples clientes.  Orientación al detalle y sensibilidad estética para acompañar en diseño, maquetación y personalización de proyectos.  Proactividad: no esperas a que el cliente pregunte, anticipas y propones.  Habilidad para gestionar prioridades y responder con agilidad en entornos cambiantes.  Nivel alto de español e inglés (oral y escrito).    🌟  ¿Qué te ofrecemos en Vidext?     Salario fijo: 26.000-34.000€ brutos anuales + variable  Contrato indefinido desde el inicio.  Beneficios fiscales: comida, transporte y guardería.  23 días de vacaciones para desconectar y recargar energía, además de Nochebuena y Nochevieja libres para disfrutar de las fiestas.  Equipo joven y dinámico en una startup en crecimiento, con ambiente colaborativo y apoyo constante.  Aprendizaje y desarrollo profesional con oportunidades reales para crecer y formarte. title: Entry level Customer Success Manager (€30-€60k salary + commission)
description: We’re looking for entry level graduates, non-graduates and career changers as Tangent’s network grows globally across London, Barcelona, Berlin, Amsterdam and more. The starting salary is €30-€60k + commission.       What is Tangent      Tangent has created a new way to apply for jobs where industry expert mentors already working in the best companies provide free mentoring and support through the application process. On Tangent jobseekers sign-up and then connect with mentors for help with their CV, applications, industry advice and even support with salary negotiations. In today’s job market it’s almost impossible to get hired without the help of a mentor, they’ve been through the process in their career and want to give back by volunteering.     Tangent is a social impact platform built to help socially diverse backgrounds break into tech. Only 9% of tech employees come from low socioeconomic backgrounds, despite them making up 39% of the total population! That's worse than law, consulting and banking! We’re on a mission to change this and we need your help!     No previous experience or a degree is required, just a passion for the mission - helping jobseekers get hired with the help of a mentor      What you’ll do:        Client Onboarding:  Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and successful introduction to Tangent's services.   Relationship Management:  Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with assigned clients, acting as their trusted advisor.   Understanding Client Needs:  Proactively understand your clients' business objectives, challenges, and desired outcomes.   Value Demonstration:  Demonstrate the value of Tangent's services by providing regular updates, insights, and best practice recommendations.   Adoption and Engagement:  Drive product adoption and engagement through training, support, and proactive communication.   Problem Solving:  Identify and resolve client issues promptly and effectively, escalating where necessary.   Retention and Growth:  Work to reduce churn and identify opportunities to expand client accounts.   Feedback Collection:  Gather client feedback and share insights with the product and development teams to improve our services.   Advocacy:  Encourage clients to become advocates for Tangent through testimonials, case studies, and referrals.   Performance Tracking:  Monitor client health metrics and proactively address any potential issues to ensure success.   Reporting:  Prepare and deliver regular client reports, highlighting key achievements and areas for improvement.       Why Join Tangent?        Competitive Salary and Commission:  Earn a competitive base salary plus uncapped commission based on performance. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package.   Make a Real Impact:  You'll be directly contributing to our mission of helping jobseekers get hired with the help of a mentor   Career Growth:  We're a rapidly growing company with plenty of opportunitie

title: Broadcom SPOC & PSO-Teamlead
description: Placeringsort: Eskilstuna, Kalmar, Karlskrona, Karlstad, Jönköping, Linköping, Norrköping, Nyköping, Skara, Västerås, Växjö, Örebro, Borlänge, Gävle, Luleå, Piteå, Kiruna, Umeå, Skellefteå, Sundsvall, Örnsköldsvik, Östersund   Vill du ta nästa steg i karriären och kombinera affärsdriv med struktur, noggrannhet och starka kundrelationer? Motiveras du av att utveckla affärer tillsammans med kunder som redan har valt Atea och skapa värde i långsiktiga samarbeten?  Som PSO-teamlead får du en viktig roll i att driva och utveckla PSO partnerprogram med Broadcom inom Atea. Förutom att vara spindeln i nätet vad gäller administration och kompetens kring programmet stöttar du också våra interna kundteam i projektleveransfrågor. Du är den främsta kontakten för Broadcom PSO, SPOC, där du bidrar till vår långsiktiga strategi- och kompetensplan inom PSO. Du samarbetar tätt med Strategiska Parters-organisationen och våra regionala affärsområdeschefer på Hybrid Platforms där du presenterar framgång och förslag på väg framåt.  Låter det spännande? Då kan detta vara din chans!   Din roll   I rollen som PSO-teamlead har du ansvar för att utveckla vårt erbjudande och affären hos befintliga kunder. Du arbetar nära kund- och konsultteamen samt leverantören för att förstå kundens behov och identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter.  Rollen kräver god struktur, noggrannhet och affärsmässig precision. Du hanterar projekt, tar fram resursförslag samt planerar och följer upp utförandet där säkerställer hög kvalitet i våra leveranser.  Till din hjälp har du ett av IT-branschens starkaste varumärken, ett nära samarbete med en marknadsledande leverantör och kompetenta team som tillsammans arbetar för att utveckla långsiktiga och värdeskapande kundrelationer.   Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter i rollen är att:     Löpande skapa samt uppdatera underlag så att Atea bygger rätt kompetens och tar rätt certifieringar för att genomföra både Broadcom PSO och andra leveransuppdrag. Underlag delges regionala KC inom Hybrid att agera på.  Löpande upprätthålla underlag så att Atea proaktivt kan bemanna PSO-uppdrag.  Ansvara för den strategiska dialogen med Broadcom gällande PSO samt fungera som intern och extern kontaktperson för PSO- och leveransuppdrag, med fokus på att stärka relationen och positionera Atea som en av Broadcoms främsta partner inom området. I dialog med Ateas leveransteam, kund och Broadcom preparera genomförandet av PSO uppdraget inklusive planering av resurstillsättning.  Verka för att Atea med optimala verktyg och metoder utför PSO uppdragen med kvalitet, hög lönsamhet och kundnöjdhet.  Verka för att Atea utvecklar tjänsteaffären kopplat till Broadcom/Vmware i faserna advise-build-run      Vem är du?   Du är en driven, affärsmässig och strukturerad person som motiveras av att skapa resultat genom långsiktiga och förtroendefulla kundrelationer. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera kund- och leverantörsdialog samt utveckla affären med noggrannhet, uppföljning och admin

title: Regional Key Client Manager
description: About This Role   We are looking for a Regional Key Client Manager to develop strategic customer partnerships, drive business growth, and enhance performance across the customer's end-to-end supply chain.   Key Responsibilities     Develop and execute global account strategies to drive growth across Ocean, Logistics & Services products.  Build customer-centric, end-to-end solutions in partnership with cross-functional teams.  Own account performance, including customer satisfaction, revenue growth, and profitability.  Lead and align global teams across functions, products, and geographies to deliver a seamless customer experience.  Establish trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers across customer organizations.  Lead global tender processes and commercial negotiations to secure sustainable business outcomes.  Ensure successful onboarding, implementation, and governance throughout the customer lifecycle.     Who We Are Looking For   To be successful in this role we believe you bring the following competencies and experiences:    Expertise in Project Logistics, with Energy sector experience considered an advantage.  Deep understanding of supply chain solutions, with the ability to optimize customer outcomes across products and services.  Experience in consultative, insight-led selling and developing value-driven customer solutions.  Proven ability to build trusted relationships, influence stakeholders, and navigate complex organizations.  Strong commercial acumen, including negotiation, procurement, and financial analysis.  Solid understanding of logistics and supply chain products and their application to customer challenges.  Experience creating value through strategic partnerships and cross-functional collaboration within a matrix environment.  Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior decision-makers.     The position is based in Aarhus, Denmark, and applicants must already have residence in Denmark.   Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.  We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Business Development Leader - Wireless
description: Overview   Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.  Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.   Responsibilities   As the  Wireless Industry Solution Expert , you will be the strategic business and technical leader interfacing between wireless customers and Keysight’s internal organizations. You will drive business growth through executive engagement, customer advocacy, market insight, and cross-solution orchestration. This is a high-impact role that combines domain expertise, business acumen, and leadership.   You Will     Serve as the trusted technical advisor to wireless customers and eco-system, with a focus on the Europe and Middle East market  Uncover, shape, and accelerate strategic opportunities that leverage Keysight’s full product and solution portfolio as the industry evolves from 5G to 6G, with demand driven by Artificial Intelligence  Working in partnership with the Sales team, help define and execute account strategies aligned with long-term company goals     Customer & Strategic Account Leadership     Build and maintain executive-level relationships (engineering, procurement, R&D, strategy) with top accounts  Uncover near-term and strategic opportunities, and coordinate internally with cross functional to advance them  Co-lead, with Sales leaders, on collaboration structure and pipeline clarity  Continuously monitor bookings and revenue performance; escalate or engage business leadership for high-stakes technical or strategic discussions  Drive gains in market share by integrating and orchestrating multi-domain Keysight solutions (hardware, software, services)  Collaborate with Account Managers and business leaders to co-develop multi-year account plans and feed insights to the technical teams  Iterate and refine your account engagement model over time, learning from successes, failures, and evolving market dynamics     Market Intelligence & Influence     Act as Keysight’s eyes and ears on the ground: regularly gather, analyze, and report trends in the operators vertical (growth forecasts, technology shifts, customer priorities, competitor moves)  Provide “outside-in” insights to internal teams—product planning, go-to-market, centers of excellence—so Keysight remains ahead of market needs     Strategic Customer Programs & Solution Adoption     Initiate and lead early-stage engagements with wireless operators

title: Customer Success Team Lead (Long Tail)
description: About The Role   We are looking for an experienced  Customer Success Team Lead  to manage our Long Tail team and drive measurable impact on Net Revenue Retention (NRR) across our Tier 3 segment.  In this high-visibility role, you will own both strategy and execution for a team of 5 Customer Success Specialists. You will be responsible for improving retention among customers who have submitted churn requests, while also building a proactive, data-driven approach to identify and mitigate risk earlier, reducing churn before it happens.  This is a pivotal moment for the team as we transition from a reactive, churn-request-led model to a proactive Customer Success motion focused on preventing churn and scaling retention impact.   Your mission     Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5 Customer Success Specialists managing Tier 3 accounts, fostering a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.  Drive the transformation from a reactive retention model to a proactive Customer Success approach by implementing data-driven churn prevention strategies and identifying customer risks early.  Own and drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets for the Tier 3 segment, continuously improving retention outcomes and reducing churn.  Monitor and leverage customer health signals, including product usage, engagement, support interactions, and NPS, to proactively manage account risk.  Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and coaching sessions to build a high-performing and engaged team.  Maintain a hands-on approach by supporting customer conversations and stepping in when additional team capacity is needed.  Design, document, and continuously optimize scalable Customer Success processes and workflows.  Partner with Revenue Operations to improve reporting, automate workflows, and ensure data-driven prioritization of team efforts.  Establish clear operational standards, escalation paths, and service-level expectations for the Tier 3 segment.  Collaborate closely with Sales, Care, Marketing, Product, and Revenue Operations teams to deliver a seamless customer experience, identify growth opportunities, and drive continuous improvement through customer feedback.     About You     5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including at least 2–3 years in a people management or team leadership position.  Proven success driving retention, reducing churn, and improving Net Revenue Retention in a B2B SaaS environment.  Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing Customer Success processes and workflows.  Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer health data, cohort analyses, and churn metrics to inform decisions.  Excellent communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead teams through change.  Full professional proficiency in both French and English, written and spoken.     Our Offer     Competitive salary + performance bonus tied to forecast accuracy and GTM outcomes

description: Job Description Summary   Do you want to drive world-class service excellence and transform how we deliver value to our customers in a global energy environment? We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.  エージェント時代（agentic era）における労働力の変革をリードする企業で、キャリアをレベルアップさせる準備はできていますか？ここがまさにその場所です！AgentforceはAIの未来であり、あなたはSalesforceの未来です。 当社のカスタマーサクセス・メソドロジーを活用し、お客様のステークホルダーと連携して目標を理解し、彼らの能力を評価した上で、ビジネスおよびテクノロジーの目標達成を加速させるための提案を行う  Salesforceの啓蒙: お客様のSalesforce導入状況に対する理解と知識を深め、当社のすべてのクラウドにおけるSalesforceの機能をエバンジェライズ（啓蒙）する。  ベストプラクティスの提示: お客様のニーズに基づき、組織戦略、ガバナンス、およびチェンジマネジメント（変革管理）のベストプラクティスについて顧客を導く。  リスクの特定と軽減: お客様が掲げるビジネス目標の達成を阻害するリスクをプロアクティブに特定し、アカウントチームと連携してリスク軽減計画を策定する。   [Technical CSMで特に求められる職務]   実践的な製品知識の提供: プラットフォームの機能や特長をお客様のビジネスの優先事項やロードマップに適用することで、Salesforce製品に関する実践的な知識を示す。  テクニカルインサイトの提供によるCustomer Enablementの推進: 製品アップデートや障害、サポート終了（EOL）等の技術情報を「顧客の価値」へと翻訳し、IT/業務部門がテクノロジーを最大限に活用できるよう伴走、支援する。   [Industry CSMで特に求められる職務]   定着化計画の策定・実行: 現状、タイムラインを伴う目標とする将来像、およびその基盤となるイネーブルメント（定着・活用化）計画を示す、包括的なアダプション（定着化）パスを作成し、実行する。  価値とイノベーションの提供: お客様の主要なビジネス課題と成長の可能性を理解し、お客様のビジネスに価値とイノベーションを提供する。     歓迎されるスキル (Preferred Skills)     特定のクラウドにおける深い知識。  顧客のビジネス価値を推進する「Trusted Advisor」として働いた実績と強力なコンサルティングスキル  Salesforce製品およびプラットフォームの機能、性能、ベストプラクティスに関する理解があることが望まれる。  技術的およびビジネス上の概念を迅速に理解し、明確に説明できる能力。  以下の経験・知識のうち、少なくとも1つを有すること：   ビジネスプロセス（営業、サービス、マーケティング、サポート）、ビジネスアプリケーション、および自動化に関する深い知識。  AIおよび機械学習の概念の理解、エージェントプラットフォームの理解、エージェントの構成および展開方法に関する深い知識。  エンタープライズレベルのソフトウェア開発ライフサイクルやプロジェクトマネジメント経験。 description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Client Implementation Manager (Card Issuing) based in Sweden.   This role leads end-to-end client implementations for card issuing programs, from initial planning through launch and formal project closure. You will serve as the primary client contact, coordinating delivery across technical and business stakeholders. The position combines project management, card issuing expertise, technical onboarding, and regulatory awareness. You will guide clients through card program configuration, API integration, testing, certification, and go-live readiness. Working closely with engineering, product, compliance, risk, and support teams, you will identify dependencies and resolve issues before they affect delivery. The role suits someone who enjoys ownership, structured problem-solving, and delivering complex fintech projects in a remote, international environment. Build and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, dependency maps, risk registers, and issue trackers.   Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing clear progress updates and managing expectations across stakeholders and competing priorities.   Lead client kickoff meetings, regular progress reviews, post-launch discussions, and other implementation touchpoints.   Coordinate delivery across engineering, product, compliance, risk, support, and other internal teams to maintain momentum and resolve blockers.   Guide clients through card program configuration, including BIN ranges and structures, product codes, card profiles, limits, fees, and authorization parameters.   Support technical onboarding covering issuing APIs, environments, system configuration, credentials, webhooks, and user access.   Coordinate dependencies involving BIN sponsors, card schemes, card bureaux, and third-party vendors, including certification, personalization, production, and fulfillment.   Lead user acceptance testing by preparing card lifecycle and transaction test plans, coordinating test card provisioning, tracking defects, and validating results.   Coordinate go-live activities, including cutover planning, readiness checks, go/no-go criteria, and post-launch hypercare.   Work with Compliance and relevant stakeholders to ensure implementations address applicable requirements, including PCI DSS, SCA/PSD2, and Visa and Mastercard rules.   Maintain complete project documentation, meeting records, decisions, configuration details, status reports, and sign-offs to support audit and compliance requirements.   Complete project handovers to Support, ensuring known issues, configurations, and relevant documentation are transferred effectively. Our partner is looking for a Client Implementation Manager (Card Issuing) based in Saudi Arabia.   This role leads end-to-end client implementations for card issuing programs, from initial planning through launch and formal project closure. You will serve as the primary client contact, coordinating delivery across technical and business stakeholders. The position combines project management, card issuing expertise, technical onboarding, and regulatory awareness. You will guide clients through card program configuration, API integration, testing, certification, and go-live readiness. Working closely with engineering, product, compliance, risk, and support teams, you will identify dependencies and resolve issues before they affect delivery. The role suits someone who enjoys ownership, structured problem-solving, and delivering complex fintech projects in a remote, international environment.  Accountabilities    Manage card issuing implementations end to end, from project planning and kickoff through launch, hypercare, and formal closure.   Build and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, dependency maps, risk registers, and issue trackers.   Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing clear progress updates and managing expectations across stakeholders and competing priorities.   Lead client kickoff meetings, regular progress reviews, post-launch discussions, and other implementation touchpoints.   Coordinate delivery across engineering, product, compliance, risk, support, and other internal teams to maintain momentum and resolve blockers.   Guide clients through card program configuration, including BIN ranges and structures, product codes, card profiles, limits, fees, and authorization parameters.   Support technical onboarding covering issuing APIs, environments, system configuration, credentials, webhooks, and user access.   Coordinate dependencies involving BIN sponsors, card schemes, card bureaux, and third-party vendors, including certification, personalization, production, and fulfillment.   Lead user acceptance testing by preparing card lifecycle and transaction test plans, coordinating test card provisioning, tracking defects, and validating results.   Coordinate go-live activities, including cutover planning, readiness checks, go/no-go criteria, and post-launch hypercare.   Work with Compliance and relevant stakeholders to ensure implementations address applicable requirements, including PCI DSS, SCA/PSD2, and Visa and Mastercard rules.   Maintain complete project documentation, meeting records, decisions, configuration details, status reports, and sign-offs to support audit and compliance requirements.   Complete project handovers to Support, ensuring known issues, configurations, and relevant documentation are transferred effectively.   Use AI tools and LLMs where appropriate to streamline project plans, meet

title: COMMISSIONING MANAGER
description: Il nostro Cliente è un’azienda imprenditoriale in crescita specializzata a livello internazionale nella progettazione e produzione di soluzioni di automazione industriale su commessa. Per rafforzare la propria struttura Operations ci ha commissionato la ricerca di un:       COMMISSIONING MANAGER      Il candidato, riportando al Direttore Operations, avrà un ruolo chiave nel coordinamento delle attività di commissioning degli impianti, collaborando quotidianamente con reparti produttivi, Ufficio Tecnico e Ufficio Commerciale.  Ricerchiamo una persona autorevole e pragmatica, con forte credibilità tecnica e personale e capacità di collaborare efficacemente con i reparti produttivi e l’Ufficio Tecnico.      Responsabilità principali:   • Gestire il commissioning degli impianti, coordinando le attività di collaudo interno, installazione, collaudo e avviamento presso il cliente.  • Assicurare il rispetto delle tempistiche e degli obiettivi delle commesse più critiche.  • Collaborare con il Responsabile di Produzione, fungendo da punto di riferimento operativo.  • Coordinare funzionalmente le attività dell’area Produzione durante le fasi di assemblaggio, avviamento e messa in servizio.  • Garantire il rispetto delle specifiche tecniche, dei tempi e dei costi di progetto, coordinando le diverse funzioni aziendali coinvolte e assicurando il corretto avanzamento delle attività fino alla messa in servizio dell'impianto.  • Coordinare le risorse di Back Office dedicate all'organizzazione delle attività di commissioning.      Requisiti:   • Laurea in Ingegneria o Diploma a indirizzo tecnico.  • Esperienza pluriennale in ruoli di responsabilità nell'ambito del commissioning, della produzione/pianificazione produzione o del project management, maturata in aziende che progettano e realizzano macchinari, impianti o linee automatiche/robotizzate su commessa.  • Solida conoscenza delle dinamiche di costruzione e assemblaggio di macchinari e impianti industriali.  • Gradita esperienza su automazione industriale.  • Ottime doti relazionali, spiccate capacità organizzative e operative, orientamento al risultato, senso di responsabilità, leadership.  • Buona dimestichezza con software gestionali.  • Conoscenza della lingua inglese.     Sede di lavoro: Provincia Nord di Treviso.  Lavoro in presenza.     Range di RAL indicativo offerto: € 60.000-65.000.     L’annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto della normativa vigente. I dati personali saranno trattati esclusivamente per le finalità connesse alla selezione, nel rispetto della normativa vigente in materia di protezione dei dati personali.

title: Manager, Portfolio Optimization
location: Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description: About the role   To drive growth and optimize the value of Sun Life Malaysia's existing customer portfolio through data-led segmentation, cross-sell and upsell strategies, targeted campaign development and disciplined execution across distribution channels. The role identifies customer needs and protection gaps, develops relevant value propositions, and oversees the end-to-end cross-sell campaign portfolio in partnership with Distribution, Product, Data Analytics, Underwriting, Marketing, Operations, Client Engagement, Digital, Finance and other key stakeholders.   Key responsibilities    Develop and execute strategies to optimize the value of the existing customer portfolio, analyzing customer demographics, product holdings, policy tenure, life stage, financial behavior and engagement patterns to identify protection and financial planning gaps.  Partner with Data Analytics to seize opportunities, define actionable segments and establish campaign eligibility criteria.  Develop structured cross-sell, upsell and next-best-offer strategies based on customer needs, existing holdings, life stage, financial profile and prior underwriting outcomes.  Work with Product, Underwriting, Distribution and Marketing to create differentiated, customer-relevant offers and sales narratives.  Own and maintain the organization's cross-sell campaign pipeline and annual or quarterly roadmap.  Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on customer value, revenue or annualized first-year premium potential, strategic importance, conversion potential, cost, return on investment, complexity and resource needs.  Oversee campaigns from ideation through implementation, monitoring and closure, with clear objectives, ownership, milestones, risks and success measures.  Coordinate cross-functional workstreams covering data and leads, product, underwriting, operations, finance, legal, compliance, marketing, client engagement, sales enablement, reporting and digital support.  Design customer engagement and re-engagement journeys across advisor, partner and digital touchpoints.  Identify and profile priority client segments using demographic, life-stage, financial, behavioural, product-holding and channel data to define target needs, eligibility and commercial potential.    About you    Bachelor's degree in marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field.  Approximately 5 years of relevant experience in insurance, banking, financial services, customer portfolio management, bancassurance, customer relationship management, marketing strategy or campaign management.  Experience in customer segmentation, cross-selling, portfolio analytics or campaign management is strongly preferred.  Good understanding of insurance products, customer lifecycle and distribution channels.  Proven experience managing cross-functional projects and stakeholders from strategy through implementation. title: Market Manager
description: About the role:    Remote, based in Japan      Own a portfolio of directly contracted hotels across Japan, and decide how far you can take it.  Nuitée is growing its direct hotel supply across Japan, and this is the next portfolio ready for someone to take full ownership of.     As Market Manager, you'll be the go-to person for every hotel partner you manage: setting the commercial strategy, keeping pricing and availability sharp, and making sure each property is fully activated and performing.     You'll work hand in hand with hotel revenue managers, GMs, and cluster teams, using Nuitée's dashboards to catch performance gaps early and turn them into fixes before they cost bookings.     It's a hands-on, high-ownership role, and one where near-native Japanese and real knowledge of the local hotel market aren't nice-to-haves — they're what it takes to run commercial conversations with Japanese hotel partners and actually move pricing and promotions forward.      What makes it interesting for you:    You own the commercial strategy for your own portfolio: pricing, promotions, availability, and which hotels get switched back on  You're the direct link between Nuitée and hotel revenue managers and GMs — no layers in between  You work hands-on with real-time performance dashboards built for fast decisions, not static reporting  Nuitée's direct supply team keeps growing, and Japan is one of the regions it's investing in next — early ownership here comes with room to grow as the portfolio scales      Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, stayed profitable the entire time, and raised a $48M Series A led by Accel. Demand partners like Grab and Priceline already send bookings through Nuitée's platform, and direct supply — the inventory you'd own — is a growing priority for where that demand gets filled.      The kind of problems you'll work on:    How do you get a newly signed hotel fully live and producing bookings, fast?  What's actually holding a specific hotel back — price, availability, or something more structural?  How do you turn a dashboard full of data into the two or three things worth fixing today?  How do you build a quarterly account plan a hotel partner actually finds useful?  How do you keep an issue moving until it's closed, instead of letting it sit?       This role fits someone who:    Has 5+ years specifically in a Market Manager, Area Manager, or equivalent portfolio-ownership role at an OTA, bedbank, or hotel-distribution platform  Is native or fluent in Japanese, with real working knowledge of the Japan hotel and travel market  Lives comfortably in dashboards and turns data into action instead of just tracking it  Understands hotel pricing, inventory, and connectivity well enough to spot exactly what's broken  Is highly organized and execution-driven — issues on your desk get closed, not carried into next week      You will do well here if you're proactive, hands-on, and move with a real sense of urgency. description: Rejoignez un collectif passionné chez  VISEO , où l'innovation, le partage, et l'expertise sont les piliers de notre état d'esprit.  Ce que nous allons faire ensemble ?  En tant que  leader dynamique  en pleine croissance sur SAP, nous avons doublé notre chiffre d'affaires au cours des trois dernières années. Nous sommes à la recherche de collaborateurs passionnés, prêts à contribuer, bâtir et étendre cette vision avec nous.  Vous ferez partie d'une  équipe internationale  de professionnels répartis dans plus de 20 sites dans le monde dont 7 en France.  En tant que  Manager SAP chez VISEO , vous jouerez un rôle essentiel chez nos clients en les aidant à exploiter pleinement la valeur de leurs investissements informatiques sur SAP. En combinant  stratégie, méthodologie et gestion humaine , vous contribuerez à guider nos clients vers des réussites remarquables.  En tant que membre de l’ équipe SAP Logistique Supply Chain , vous offrirez conseils éclairés sur des sujets d’actualité et qui drive les programmes de transformation majeurs chez nos clients :  l’optimisation de la Supply Chain, le RSE, les enjeux Retail et Fashion, etc .   Vos missions consisteront à :     Accompagner nos clients dans la mise en œuvre de leur Core Model en prenant en charge l’animation des ateliers de conceptions et l’intégration des processus métier avec une vision globale de bout en bout.  Fournir des solutions de haute qualité dans les délais et le budget prévus.  Être force de proposition avec la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes, efficaces en adéquation avec les enjeux clients.  Concevoir, présenter et incarner des propositions de manière captivante, tout en développant une compréhension approfondie de l'écosystème du client.  Réaliser des prototypes sous SAP S4 Hana, afin de démontrer le potentiel et les fonctionnalités SAP qui répondront aux besoins client et qui l’aideront à transformer son business  Escalader les risques aux directeurs des projets et proposer des plans d’actions pour sécuriser le niveau de service.  Identifier la stratégie de migration du domaine et sa coordination avec d’autres équipes du paysage applicatif du client.  Définir le plan de cut-over, support au dry run (évolutions / corrections), afin de sécuriser le golive ainsi qu’assurer le support post démarrage, handover aux équipes maintenance afin de pérenniser la qualité de la solution mis en œuvre.  Contribuer à l'animation de la communauté SAP des KUs / BPO / AMOA dans le but de dynamiser les échanges constructifs et de répondre aux attentes du client de manière proactive.     Construire la solution SAP de demain en accord avec la vision de nos clients :     Définir les solutions SAP Supply Chain et Logistique avec une approche globale, intégrée et flexible.  Mettre en œuvre ces solutions avec l'équipe, en devenant un pilier de cette offre  Fédérer, transformer et assurer le succès de la transition avec une énergie. Du blir limet mellom forretningsstrategien, kunder og ansatte i Netcompany.  Oppgavene vil variere og dagene vil sjelden være like. I det store og hele handler vår suksess om at vi lager løsninger som er tilpasset kundens og brukernes behov. title: Senior SAP Prosjektleder
description: Er du en erfaren SAP-prosjektleder som er klar for nye utfordringer?   Da bør du lese videre.   Hos NTT DATA Business Solutions har vi et internasjonalt miljø som ivaretar de ansattes ve og vel.   Vi ser nå etter en erfaren prosjektleder som trives med varierte virksomhetsutfordringer og samspill med mennesker. Du er en trygg og tydelig leder som ser helheten og motiverer teamet ditt til å levere de beste løsningene for våre kunder. Med din solide prosjektledererfaring bidrar du til å styrke våre verdifulle og langsiktige kunderelasjoner hver dag. Dokumentert prosjektledererfaring, gjerne med sertifiseringer som PMP, Prince2, Scrum Master eller lignende.  Erfaring med Agile og Lean arbeidsmetodikker.  Gode ferdigheter innen planlegging, dokumentasjon og rapportering.  Kommersiell teft og evne til å bygge sterke kunderelasjoner.  Utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå, eller tilsvarende relevant arbeidserfaring.  Flytende norsk og engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig og bosat i Oslo-området.     Hva kan vi tilby deg? title: Project Manager
description: As a (Senior) Project Manager you will be responsible for the delivery of medium to large customer projects at a number of client sites. You will lead projects, manage project teams, manage budget, ensure customer engagement and collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders. You will also support executive level expectations by providing internal suggestions to management, based on field experience, as to how potentially improve the Basware Deployment Methodology. You must thrive in working as a team in a fast-paced environment.  Key Responsibilities    Lead end-to-end delivery of Basware implementation and integration projects ensuring they are completed on time, within scope and budget.  Act as the primary customer contact during project execution, building trust and ensuring alignment with client goals.  Develop detailed project plans, manage schedules, track milestones, and report progress to internal and external stakeholders.  Identify risks early, develop mitigation plans and manage issues to maintain the project health. title: AI Software Engineer
description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's AI team, building Co-Analyst and the analytical AI features around it.

Co-Analyst is a user-facing multi-agent system that works alongside intelligence analysts to research and write reports. A planning loop decomposes an analyst's question, fans work out to sub-agents, and assembles the results into a report where every claim traces back to the chunk of source it came from. Underneath sits hybrid retrieval over a large unstructured corpus: analyst intent translated into structured filters, combined with keyword and dense vector search, across multiple languages and media types.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer
description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join ExTrac's AI team, building Co-Analyst and the analytical AI features around it.

Co-Analyst is a user-facing multi-agent system that works alongside intelligence analysts to research and write reports. A planning loop decomposes an analyst's question, fans work out to sub-agents, and assembles the results into a report where every claim traces back to the chunk of source it came from. Underneath sits vector search over a large unstructured corpus, across multiple languages and media types.

The agent work is the centrepiece but not the whole job. In a single quarter the work spans agent orchestration, retrieval, graph analytics, and long-running streaming pipelines, alongside the services and databases underneath them. You will own services end to end across a Python and Go codebase, working alongside the data team who own the ingestion pipelines and a research-focused ML team who train and evaluate the models we integrate and serve. The loop is short: product brings an idea, often recent and unproven, and our job is to spike an implementation and take it to a production feature. New features land close to weekly.

description:
The Role

We are looking for a Junior Automation Engineer to grow into the technical care of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) behind our fab - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. Here's the best part: you'll join during the final commissioning phase, working side by side with the specialists who bring the system to life. You'll learn it hands-on while the people who built it are still on site - and grow, step by step, into independent ownership. It's about as good a launchpad for a career in automation engineering as you'll find.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Support the operation, monitoring and maintenance of our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA) and our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs

  • Take part in loop checks - learning to trace each signal from the field device through I/O and PLC to the operator screen, and to confirm that commands move valves, dampers and actuators; one of the fastest ways to understand the whole system

  • Help investigate and resolve alarms and faults during commissioning and live operation

  • Support instrument calibration checks and field-signal troubleshooting

  • Help build datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and keep documentation up to date

  • Gradually take on more system responsibility as your confidence grows

  • Work closely with experienced colleagues and with our facility and IT teams

Your Qualifications

title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account.   • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

title: Electric Propulsion Engineer
description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Role

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you own the design of that thruster: you calculate it, design it, build it, test it in our own vacuum facilities and feed what you learn straight into the next iteration.

You own the testing of your own designs, and your results decide what flies.

  • Iterate rapidly to support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries.

  • Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers on each new iteration of the ion propulsion system.

description: Bikroy Marketplace Ltd. (A Concern of Jiji Group)  is looking for  Head of Customer Operations       Job Description / Responsibility    The Role:    The call center is the main revenue engine of Bikroy: it turns sellers who post ads into paying customers (Boost, Top, Premium and listing packages) and keeps them buying. Today, the desk is run without a strong commercial owner, and the number is below what the market allows. You take the whole function over: conversion (hot and cold), retention, support and quality, with a direct line to the Group COO. Bikroy is the first Jiji market outside Africa, and the call center playbook that already works in Nigeria, Ghana and Kenya is yours to bring to Dhaka.    Mission:  own the monthly revenue number of the call center and grow it every quarter through conversion, not call volume.   What you will own:     Revenue vs target, every month.  One target per agent; individual targets add up to the department target; targets differ by team, grade and tenure. Revenue per agent grows quarter on quarter. Any decline is escalated by you first, with the cause and the fix, before anyone asks.   Conversion and the sales playbook.  You find why some agents close and others do not on the same product and the same market (pitch, objection handling, package mix), and turn it into concrete scripts and coaching for the rest of the team. You are the first to see customer reactions, so you propose changes to packages and pricing when the lineup is hard to sell.   Team performance.  Weekly KPI file per agent (revenue, achievement %, deals, calls done vs attempts, QA score). One written rule for action: revenue threshold plus trend plus tenure decides coaching, warning, PIP or exit. You and HR bring a worked plan per agent to the quarterly review, with review dates and predefined outcomes. Calls are an input; performance is the primary criterion, QA is supporting evidence.   Motivation and structure.  You design and simulate every bonus and challenge (rate per deal = target bonus/deals per month), send a monthly bonus report with per-agent numbers and a decision for every agent below 70% of target, and keep the desk staffed: team leads who call, backup agents planned before people exit, no layer without a number.   12-month goal:  call center revenue x2 vs your first full month, conversion QA at 85%+, every agent on a target-based bonus.   Key Areas of Ownership:  QA as a sales tool (scoring probing, value, urgency, objection handling and a committed payment date, not script compliance), SOPs and escalation rules, UAT and launch readiness for new packages and campaigns from the call center side, projects assigned by Bikroy management.   Who you work with:  you report to the Group COO in a “question - decision within hours” mode. title: Strategic Account Executive - Brazil
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

title: Revenue Operations Lead
description:
The Role We Need

PadSplit's demand engine spans Marketing, Lifecycle, Member Acquisition, and Member Success, but no one owns how these teams connect once a lead is approved, leaving us blind to where members stall on the way to a move-in and unable to see which outreach actually converts. We need a Revenue Operations Lead to own the last, most critical leg of the funnel: the calling and human outreach that turns an approved lead into a housed member, along with the reporting that makes the whole funnel legible. This role starts narrow (conversion and outreach) with room to expand into the broader Demand Growth function over time.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a builder-operator with 5+ years in revenue operations, growth operations, or funnel analytics, who is fluent in SQL or a BI tool like Hex, Mode, or Looker and has real instinct for calling operations, script testing, and agent coaching. This person uses AI daily to build reporting, analyze calls, and scale outreach, and has a clear point of view on where AI makes an ops team faster. They can hold many channels at once without losing the thread, and translate a messy funnel into decisions leadership can act on.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day:

  • Optimizing call performance: Own how members convert across AI-driven calls and human phone calls, refining scripts, follow-up cadence, and objection handling.
  • Coaching agents: Test what actually moves conversion and feed findings back to human agents and the teams they support.
  • Sequencing hand-offs: Decide where AI calls hand off to a person and where a person hands off to Lifecycle.
  • Building funnel dashboards: Maintain the end-to-end view of the demand funnel — lead to approved to booked to moved-in — primarily in Hex.
  • Closing reporting gaps: Surface stage-by-stage conversion, drop-off, and velocity without re-deriving data each time.
  • Driving retention outreach: Partner with Member Success to flag churn-risk changes and behavioral events, and proactively reach out before a member decides to leave.
  • Standing up interventions: Launch retention and transfer offers as caller campaigns or lifecycle text messages.
  • Fixing the stack: Bring order to lead routing, CRM hygiene, and experiment instrumentation, and set clear SLAs across Performance Marketing, Lifecycle, MA, and Member Success.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful:

  • RevOps background: 5+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, growth operations, or funnel analytics, ideally in a marketplace, subscription, or high-volume consumer-sales environment.

En tant que Business Development Representative chez Amenitiz, vous prenez en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact de prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste centré uniquement sur la prise de rendez-vous. Vous prospectez, réalisez des démonstrations, traitez les objections et concluez les ventes, tout en gérant votre pipeline et votre contribution au chiffre d'affaires de bout en bout.

Avec plus de 15 000 clients et une note de satisfaction de 4,8/5, notre produit bénéficie d'une forte reconnaissance sur le marché.

Vous commercialiserez une solution qui a un impact concret et mesurable sur le quotidien de ses utilisateurs, tout en étant pleinement responsable de l'ensemble du processus qui leur permet d'y accéder.

(Ce rôle est basé à Lyon, en France)

title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

title: Category Manager ( CDD de remplacement temporaire )
description:
Le groupe Lovehoney est le leader mondial du bien-être sexuel. Sa mission est d’améliorer le plaisir grâce à des technologies innovantes et à une approche fondée sur les données, tout en favorisant des perspectives créatives et originales sur l’intimité. Nous proposons des marques passionnantes avec des sextoys, de la lingerie et des accessoires innovants et de haute qualité, le tout dans le cadre d’une expérience d’achat en ligne simplifiée.

Chez Lovehoney, nous employons plus de 800 personnes passionnées et avant-gardistes réparties dans 9 bureaux à travers le monde, chacune apportant un mélange unique de talents à notre effectif diversifié. Nous sommes fiers d’être une entreprise qui prospère en faisant les choses différemment, en remettant en question les attentes et les stéréotypes tout en ayant un impact positif sur la vie de nos clients.

Rejoignez-nous chez Lovehoney, où le plaisir s’allie à la créativité, aux données et à l’innovation !


Missions et Responsabilités

Nous recherchons, dans le cadre d'un CDD de remplacement temporaire,  un/e Category Manager  pour rejoindre notre équipe et prendre en charge la qualité, l’enrichissement et la performance de nos fiches produits sur nos deux sites e-commerce : espaceplaisir et SexyAvenue.

Vous n'êtes pas simplement en charge des fiches produit : vous êtes celui ou celle qui garantit que chaque produit est complet, bien présenté et connecté aux bons produits complémentaires sur Magento. Vous êtes garant(e) de la qualité des données produit, de la pertinence des associations cross-sell et de l'impact éditorial des fiches produit sur l'ensemble des sites (espaceplaisir, SexyAvenue), avec un objectif clair : maximiser la conversion et le panier moyen.

title: Stockiste (H/F) - Aix en Provence - CDI
description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Sézane est un terrain de jeu où chaque journée ne ressemble à aucune autre, votre poste d’aujourd’hui ne sera peut-être plus celui d’hier et probablement pas celui de demain. Ça vous parle ? Écrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Stockiste (H/F) en 35H pour rejoindre nos équipes retail à partir du mois de Novembre 2026 en CDI.
Ce poste est basé à Aix en Provence (13).


Rattaché(e) au Directeur de l’Appartement vos principales responsabilités seront : 

Garantir une gestion efficace du stock 

En Appartement  :

  • Garantir la bonne réception des livraisons (déballages, tri, étiquetage, bipage, rangement) ;
  • Enregistrer les livraisons en suivant les processus ;
  • Effectuer le réassort quotidien de la boutique dans le respect des standards de merchandising ;
  • Assurer la bonne tenue de la réserve en garantissant un rangement rigoureux et optimal ;
  • Suivre le bon déroulement des procédures de transferts entre les boutiques ;
  • Participer aux inventaires (volants, mensuels, fiscaux) de la boutique ;

title: VIP Helicopter Captain - ACH135 | Yacht-Based | Mediterranean & Caribbean
description:
A private Family Office is seeking an experienced VIP Helicopter Captain for a yacht-based operation aboard a superyacht, operating on a dual-season basis between the Mediterranean and the Caribbean. The Role

  • Deck landings (day and night) on the yacht's helipad, plus operations at private and public locations across both cruising regions
  • Close coordination with the yacht's captain, crew and shore-side operations team
  • Full responsibility for flight safety, operational standards and passenger experience at the highest level of discretion


Roster
3 weeks on / 3 weeks off, though in practice flexible around operational need — off time coordinated directly with the operating captain team rather than a rigid fixed pattern.

Requirements

  • ATPL(H), current type rating or ability to obtain one
  • Minimum 3,000+ total flight hours, meaningful twin-engine and deck-landing experience
  • Prior VIP, yacht-based, or comparable high-standards operational background strongly preferred
  • Class 1 medical, fluent English
  • Based in Europe; flexible to reposition between the Mediterranean and Caribbean seasons

Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

  • Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.

Architecture

description:
Senior Event Production Manager (Planning)

Please note: candidates must currently reside in the UK and be able to work in the UK without sponsorship.

Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

The Senior Event Production Manager (Planning) is responsible for overseeing the planning and execution of events, ensuring seamless coordination between clients and internal teams. Acting as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the planning process, this role ensures that all aspects of an event – from logistics and technical production to catering and on-site operations – are delivered to the highest standard. The role requires strong leadership, project management, and communication skills to ensure client expectations are met while maintaining operational efficiency.

Key responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and manage the Events Team, ensuring effective staff scheduling and resource allocation.

title: (Junior) Creative Director – Design & Brand (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Die Beratungsbranche in Deutschland sieht überall gleich aus. Gleiche Bildwelten, gleiche Stockfotos, gleiche Blautöne, gleiche Sprache. Marke ist in diesem Markt praktisch unbesetzt.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis. Daraus bauen wir das Beratungshaus für den deutschen Mittelstand, und wir bauen es schnell. Diesen Markt gewinnt nicht, wer den besseren Fachaufsatz schreibt, sondern wer als Marke dauerhaft präsent ist und den Markt anführt — bei Unternehmern genauso wie bei den Menschen, die wir für uns gewinnen wollen. Genau diese Marke bauen wir: ikonisch, unverwechselbar, und in dieser Branche gibt es sie noch nicht. Design ist deshalb keine Abteilung am Ende der Kette: Was wir bauen, wird aus einer Designperspektive gedacht.

Du bist Grafikdesigner mit außergewöhnlichem visuellem Gespür und einem Portfolio, das für sich spricht. Du kommst aus einer Agentur, einem eigenen Studio oder von einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Du wechselst, weil du dort immer nur einen Teilbereich verantwortest — eine Kampagne, ein Relaunch, eine Strecke im System — und nie die Marke als Ganzes samt der Experience dahinter verantworten und führen darfst. Genau das willst du: die volle visuelle Verantwortung, mit einem Auftraggeber, der dir das Urteil nicht wegnimmt.

Die Rolle ist bewusst nach unten offen. Wenn du gerade aus einem starken Gestaltungsstudium oder einer gestalterischen Ausbildung kommst und deine Mappe das visuelle Urteil und die Systemtiefe zeigt, die diese Rolle braucht, bist du hier richtig — du startest dann am unteren Ende der Spanne, arbeitest zunächst an Teilen des Systems und wächst in

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

It serves two very different buyers under one roof: a Global HR Director who checks in occasionally for a strategic view, and an L&D Manager who lives in the tool day to day running the program. Getting both right, with no live product to build on, is the job.

As Staff Product Designer, you'll own design for our Enterprise customer platform from the ground up, reporting directly to the VP of Design. You'll work as an equal partner alongside Product Management and Engineering, and you'll be the first dedicated design hire on this product, so the standards, patterns, and process you set will shape how the team designs enterprise software at Berlitz for years to come.

Als Spüler (m/w/d) sind Sie das Herzstück unserer Spülküche und sorgen dafür, dass alles rund läuft, ob im täglichen Produktionsbetrieb oder bei Events: Sie reinigen Geschirr, Besteck, Gläser, Töpfe, Bleche, GN-Behälter und Transportboxen, bedienen unsere Spülmaschine bzw. Spülstraße und halten die Spülküche sauber und ordentlich. Dabei halten Sie die Hygienevorschriften (HACCP) ein. Ohne Sie läuft in der Küche nichts.

Wichtig zum Arbeitsort:
Bis zum 31.12.2026 arbeiten Sie in unserer Spülküche im PSD BANK DOME in Düsseldorf. Ab dem 01.01.2027 ziehen wir an unseren neuen Standort in Essen. Bitte bewerben Sie sich daher nur, wenn beide Standorte für Sie in Frage kommen würden.

Arbeitszeiten:
Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Einsätzen unter der Woche in der Produktion. Je nach Veranstaltung kommen Event-Einsätze dazu, auch abends und am Wochenende. Eine gewisse Flexibilität bringen Sie daher mit.

Was Sie mitbringen:
Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in einer Spülküche, Kantine, Gemeinschaftsverpflegung oder im Eventbereich. Ein Quereinstieg ist bei uns aber ausdrücklich willkommen. Wichtiger sind uns Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist, ein sauberer Arbeitsstil und die Bereitschaft, körperlich mit anzupacken.

Design and maintain a member health-scoring model that flags disengagement and renewal risk early, and apply it consistently across the portfolio.  Build and run structured onboarding, milestone check-ins, renewal preparation, post-renewal follow-up and automated, cohort-based communications, using scalable templates and member journeys.  Provide consistent, responsive member service within clear service standards, escalating strategic, at-risk or growth opportunities to the Director where individual attention is warranted.  Establish, grow and manage peer networks and communities of practice that help members connect, participate in TCA activities and get clear value from their membership, supported by self-serve resources and engagement pathways.  Turn member feedback, engagement signals and renewal patterns into practical initiatives that reduce preventable churn and shape TCA's programs, value proposition and future offerings. title: Key Account Manager Residential Buildings
description: Responsibilities   The Key Account Manager Residential Buildings plays a crucial role within the Sales Team of the Residential Buildings Business Unit and is responsible for strategically managing, developing and expanding customer relationships and contracts. The role focuses on achieving sustainable revenue and profit growth and strengthening IMI’s market position within the Residential Buildings market.  The Key Account Manager maintains and deepens existing customer relationships while simultaneously focusing actively on developing new business. Based on a strong understanding of the market, customer needs and relevant market developments, the Key Account Manager identifies commercial opportunities and translates these into concrete sales and growth plans. This includes actively pursuing acquisition, cross-selling, deep-selling and up-selling opportunities across the full IMI portfolio, with the objective of further increasing both revenue and margin as well as IMI’s market share.  The role focuses explicitly on Key Accounts within the relevant customer groups rather than on a predetermined number of customers or exclusively on wholesalers. Within the so-called push strategy, the focus is on wholesalers, purchasing organisations and installers. Within the pull strategy, the Key Account Manager focuses, among others, on housing associations and related organisations, as well as energy consultants. By actively building and maintaining relationships throughout the entire value chain, the Key Account Manager creates a strong network in which different stakeholders are connected and commercial opportunities can be leveraged effectively.  In addition to commercial responsibility, the Key Account Manager plays an important role in the development and execution of market-oriented marketing activities. The Key Account Manager initiates, coordinates and supports activities that contribute to further strengthening IMI’s market position. These activities include organising customer events, training sessions and webinars, supporting market introductions, setting up joint marketing campaigns with partners, and developing value propositions that respond to current market developments and customer needs. This not only strengthens relationships with existing customers but also creates new market opportunities.  The Key Account Manager operates based on a strategic regional plan. This plan integrates relevant customers, commercial objectives, growth opportunities, customer needs, market developments, marketing initiatives and the corresponding IMI solutions. The regional plan therefore forms the basis for determining priorities and deploying targeted commercial and marketing activities towards Key Accounts and other strategically relevant customers. title: Information Technology Operations Manager
description: In de rol van IT Operations Manager, maak je deel uit van het managementteam. Het team is inhoudelijk sterk, klantgericht en werkt binnen een complexe, Microsoft-gebaseerde IT-omgeving.      Jouw verantwoordelijkheden ;   Je geeft dagelijks leiding aan het team en ontwikkelt het team verder op het gebied van professionaliteit, samenwerking en eigenaarschap.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor klanttevredenheid, kwaliteit van de dienstverlening en het behalen van gemaakte SLA-afspraken.  Je bewaakt daarnaast de financiële prestaties van de klantcontracten.  Je begeleidt veranderingen binnen de teamstructuur en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige overgang voor zowel klanten als medewerkers.  Je brengt structuur en focus in de dagelijkse operatie en bewaakt de balans tussen ad-hoc klantvragen en planmatig werken.  Je stuurt actief op continue verbetering van processen, kwaliteit en efficiëntie.  Je coacht servicemanagers en engineers in hun klantgerichte rol en helpt hen groeien in adviseren, communiceren en eigenaarschap.  Je bent gesprekspartner voor belangrijke klanten en neemt regelmatig deel aan klantgesprekken.  Je initieert en begeleidt verander- en verbeterinitiatieven binnen het team en werkt daarbij nauw samen met verschillende interne specialisten.  Je werkt nauw samen met andere operationeel managers en zorgt voor een goede verbinding tussen klant, team en organisatie.  Je bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar voor medewerkers, zowel op kantoor als op afstand.       We zijn op zoek naar iemand met;    Minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau.  Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als IT operations manager binnen een MSP;  Ervaring binnen IT-dienstverlening en/of managed services.  Ervaring met projectmatig werken, procesverbetering en verandermanagement.       Persoonlijkheid;     Je bent een stevige en ervaren people manager die duidelijk richting geeft.  Je wordt door teams gezien als een natuurlijke en betrouwbare leidinggevende.  Je weet mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen, spreekt medewerkers aan op verantwoordelijkheden en resultaten.  Je combineert aandacht voor medewerkers met een sterke focus op klanttevredenheid en bedrijfsresultaat.  Je bent in staat om operationele vraagstukken te vertalen naar structurele verbeteringen.  Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en schakelt gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus.  Je bent proactief, besluitvaardig en hebt een sterk gevoel voor eigenaarschap.  Je voelt je prettig in een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is en weet juist in een veranderende omgeving structuur en richting te bieden.

Wir unterstützen Menschen durch unsere Bildungsangebote praxisnah dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten für künftige Zeiten zu stärken und damit aktiv ihren Lebensweg zu gestalten. title: Customer Success Specialist

Je ondersteunt onze accountmanagers bij commerciële en operationele werkzaamheden rondom bestaande en nieuwe accounts.       Wat bieden we jou?    Een afwisselende en zelfstandige rol binnen een groeiende scale-up.  Een collegiaal team met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng.  Een goed salaris, 27 vakantiedagen en een Personal Benefit Budget 8%.  Flexibele werktijden waarbij je afwisselt tussen werken op kantoor en thuis.  Macbook en Iphone.  Persoonlijke groei- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden.       Wat breng je mee?
