Je maakt je nieuwe systemen en processen snel eigen en vindt het leuk om inhoudelijk uit te zoeken hoe iets werkt, zodat je klanten zelfstandig verder kunt helpen.  Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.  Goed organisatorisch vermogen en oog voor detail. Een stapje extra willen zetten voor de klant.       Solliciteren?   Is deze functie jou op het lijf geschreven? Solliciteer dan via onderstaand formulier.  Als je nog vragen hebt kan je mailen naar patricia@datakeeper.nl.

Vårt samlede kompetansespekter lever opp til ambisjonen om å digitalisere industrien og bedre våre kunders konkurransekraft gjennom å kombinere vår løsningskompetanse med ny software og teknologi.  Goodtech er notert på Oslo Børs, omsetter for ca. NOK 700 millioner og har i overkant av 300 medarbeidere i Norge og Sverige. description: Hos Feriepartner bliver du en del af en kæde i rivende udvikling. Branchen har været i positiv udvikling de sidste mange år, og alle prognoser tyder på, at det fortsætter. Feriepartners vedholdende fokus på ”bedre oplevelser” for årligt mere end 500.000 feriegæster og ca. 9.000 sommerhusejere på landsplan har resulteret i en konkurrencemæssigt stærk position.      Feriepartner Fanø er et nystartet bureau i en positiv udvikling og formidler pt. udlejning af ca. 80 sommerhuse. Den nuværende bureauleder har fået andre udfordringer internt i kæden. Derfor leder vi efter en engageret person til at overtage driftsledelsen og udviklingen af bureauet på Fanø. Den daglige ledelse af Feriepartner Fanø består af både en salgschef og en bureauleder, hvor bureaulederen har fokus på drift og gæster, og salgschefen har fokus på, at porteføljen af udlejningsemner udbygges med sommerhuse af høj kvalitet. De fastansatte kollegaer er udover bureaulederen og salgschefen en Ferierådgiver samt en gruppe af timelønnede rengørings- og servicemedarbejdere.     Du bliver en del af en mindre virksomhed i vækst, hvor det er vigtigt, at du passer ind i et mindre team med åbent kontorfællesskab. Det er afgørende, at du trives med at være en central del af den daglige drift og at være hands-on ift. at servicere gæster, husejere og administrative opgaver i bred forstand samt indgår i vagtordningen i weekender og på helligdage. Du får ansvaret for at navigere gennem den travle sommersæson med et smil og en rolig hånd, hvor du i vintermånederne har et større fokus på strategiske udviklingsprojekter.     Din mission er at sikre Danmarks bedste oplevelse til gæster og husejere gennem lokal tilstedeværelse og evnen til at imødekomme individuelle behov. Din væsentligste opgave bliver sammen med salgschefen at gå forrest, når budget og målsætninger skal indfries. Du bliver en nøglefigur i Feriepartners fremtidige udvikling, hvor der er store ambitioner både lokalt og på landsplan. Din stemme er vigtig for hele kæden, og du vil være med til at præge både lokale initiativer og samarbejdet på tværs af de mange selvstændige bureauer i hele landet. Du bliver det lokale ansigt for Feriepartner Fanø, hvor du aktivt deltager i dialogen med lokale samarbejdspartnere og bidrager til et stærkt lokalsamfund. title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö Vaasan myymäläämme
description: Etsimme Vaasan Normal-myymäläämme iloisen ja energisen asenteen omaavaa apulaismyymäläpäällikköä!   Apulaismyymäläpäällikkönä olet avainasemassa luomassa asiakkaille uniikkia osto- ja asiakaskokemusta. Toimit myymäläpäällikön kanssa tiiminä, motivoiden ja kehittäen työntekijöitä avoimessa ja iloisessa ympäristössä. Yhdessä varmistatte, että myymälä toimii tehokkaasti ja saavuttaa myyntitavoitteet. Myymälän visuaalinen ilme ja tiimin johtaminen ovat intohimosi. Pääset perehtymään tehtävääsi huippuosaajien kanssa, jonka tavoitteena on antaa sinulle alkustartti ammatilliseen ja henkilökohtaiseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen. Kenties mielenkiintosi on toimia jonakin päivänä NORMAL-ketjun myymäläpäällikkönä!  NORMAL on nuori dynaaminen yritys, joka on muutaman vuoden aikana avannut satoja myymälöitä ympäri Euroopan. Myös Suomessa kasvumme jatkuu edelleen.  Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme pysyvästi matalat hinnat ja useita tuhansia ”normaaleja” tuotteita mm. kemikalio-, kosmetiikka- ja kotitaloustuotteiden saralla, unohtamatta jännittäviä uutuuksia joka viikko useissa eri tuotekategorioissa. NORMAL on yritys, jossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia ja meillä on yhteiset menestymis- ja tulostavoitteet - ja samalla pidämme hauskaa yhdessä.   Mitä Toivomme Sinulta     olet kunnianhimoinen ja kerännyt kokemusta esihenkilönä toimimisesta - tuemme sinua roolissasi  asiakaspalvelu on intohimosi – asiakas on aina tärkein  olet motivoitunut, määrätietoinen ja väsymätön tiiminjohtaja – innostat ja motivoit omalla esimerkilläsi  paineensietokykyä – nopeatempoinen työ vie sinut mennessään ja uppoudut siihen mielelläsi  myymälän johtaminen ja kauppiashenkinen toiminen saa sinun syttymään – lukujen seuraaminen tukee myyntiä  omaat itsenäiset työskentelytaidot, mutta ymmärrät tiimin voiman – yhdessä on hauskempaa  sinulla on visuaalista silmää – esillepanojen teko best!  työt sijoittuvat niin aamu-, ilta- kuin välivuoroihinkin – monipuoliset työajat  kommunikoit vaivattomasti suomeksi ja asiakkaiden palvelu englanniksi onnistuu myös - but of course!  myymäläpäällikön ollessa poissa hyppäät puikkoihin empimättä ja varmistat myymäläntoiminnan     Mikäli etsit inspiroivaa, hauskaa ja menevää työpaikkaa, hae ihmeessä meille ja tule osaksi mahtavaa porukkaamme!  Maksamme palkkaa TES:in mukaisesti.   Oletko se sinä?   Odotamme innolla hakemustasi ja arvostamme myös videon muodossa tulevaa esittelyä! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista, ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Team Lead Retail & Customer Support (m/w/d), 80-100%
description: Stromer lebt Swissness, Begeisterung und Partnerschaft.      Die myStromer AG entwickelt seit 2009 international ausgezeichnete Speed Pedelecs, die mit herausragender Leistung, Konnektivität und Design den urbanen Verkehr neu definieren. Unser Ziel: Die besten S-Pedelecs zu entwickeln und Menschen zu begeistern, sie täglich zu benutzen. Dafür bündeln wir an unserem Stromer Campus in Oberwangen alle Kompetenzen unter einem Dach – von der Entwicklung, über die Montage, das Marketing, bis zum Vertrieb. Denn mit jeder einzelnen Idee gestalten wir gemeinsam die Mobilität von morgen.     Seit 2022 gehört auch die Marke Desiknio zum Portfolio der myStromer AG. Unsere Marken Stromer und Desiknio verbindet eine hohe Innovationskraft, vollintegriertes Design, führende Technologie sowie erstklassige Qualität. Zusammen verfolgen wir den Anspruch, die Zukunft der Mobilität mit mehr Fahrfreude, Effizienz und Lebensqualität zu gestalten. Gleichzeitig ist Desiknio die ideale Ergänzung für das Stromer Produktportfolio. Die Premium-E-Bikes von Desiknio, die in Spanien entworfen und in Europa handgefertigt werden, sind mit einer Unterstützung bis 25 km/h perfekt für den innerstädtischen Verkehr und kürzere Strecken geeignet.     An unserem Hauptsitz in Oberwangen suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte, lösungsorientierte und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit als      Team Lead Retail & Customer Support (m/w/d), 80-100%      Als Team Lead Retail & Customer Support bist du verantwortlich für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Retail- und Customer-Support-Organisation in der DACH-Region, Frankreich sowie bei Bedarf in weiteren Märkten. Du stellst einen effizienten, qualitativ hochwertigen und kundenorientierten Support für Kunden und Handelspartner sicher und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung einer skalierbaren internationalen Supportorganisation bei.     Dabei verbindest du operative Führung, technische Expertise und moderne Technologien wie KI, Automatisierung und Self-Service-Lösungen, um unseren Fachhandelspartnern und Kundinnen sowie Kunden einen erstklassigen Service zu bieten. Du sorgst dafür, dass Probleme schnell gelöst, Prozesse kontinuierlich verbessert und wertvolle Erkenntnisse für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte gewonnen werden. description: Job title:  Senior Service Manager – Run & Maintain | Doha, Qatar      The role   A government ministry in Qatar is building a national digital platform. It brings services from many government and private-sector organisations into one place for citizens. Once it goes live, someone has to make sure it keeps working.  You will be the first hire in the programme's service management function. Your first job is to settle who is responsible for each part of the platform: infrastructure, application updates, the API gateway, identity and login, and the connections to each organisation. Some of these are currently unassigned or only assumed. You then design the service levels, on-call rota, incident escalation and tooling around that ownership.  You also run it. We need someone who has taken an operating model off paper and into daily practice, trained the people who use it, and stayed with it after go-live.   What you'll do    Agree who owns each part of the platform across the delivery vendor, the hosting provider and the programme  Design SLAs, on-call rotas and escalation paths  Roll out the operating model, train the teams, and own it once it's live  Coordinate incidents between the vendor, the hosting provider, the citizen support channel and the affected organisation, so citizens don't have to explain an issue twice  Specify and bring in a shared ticketing system, such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management  Set up first-line citizen support with the government service channel  Report on service performance, incidents and risk to programme leadership  Lead service readiness for go-live and stabilisation afterwards  Build and lead the service management team    What you'll bring    8–10+ years in IT service management or service operations  Experience setting up a service management function from scratch on a large multi-vendor programme  ITIL-based operating model design: RACI, SLAs, incident and problem management, on-call  A record of coordinating several parties where no one of them owns the whole service  Incident management on a live, public-facing digital service  Experience specifying and implementing ITSM tooling  Clear reporting to non-technical senior leaders  Government or regulated-sector experience is a plus  ITIL 4 is a plus (Managing Professional preferred); ServiceNow certification also a plus  A degree in IT, computer science, business or a related subject   The role includes on-call duty outside normal hours as the platform grows.   To apply   Send your CV with a few lines on a service management function you set up from scratch: how many vendors or parties were involved, and how you made it work after go-live.

Une vingtaine d’entreprises et structures tremplin le composent aujourd’hui, situées en Ile-de-France essentiellement, en Auv.-Rhône-Alpes et en Nouvelle Aquitaine. Nos activités couvrent  5 secteurs  : logistique, BTP, économie circulaire, numérique, vignes – espaces verts. Notre vocation principale est de favoriser le retour à l’emploi de personnes vulnérables : chômeurs de longue durée, bénéficiaires du RSA, personnes en situation de handicap, primo-arrivant ...   Notre conviction : personne n’est inemployable  .  Nous favorisons ainsi la remobilisation de 4 500 personnes par an, accompagnées grâce à des parcours vers l’emploi permettant de restaurer leur confiance et leur autonomie.  Notre action s’ancre dans des valeurs fortes d’engagement, de bienveillance, d’esprit d’équipe, de confiance et de professionnalisme. Et depuis 2022, nous sommes  labellisés Great Place to Work .   Acces, Inclusive Tech  est l’aboutissement d’une collaboration entre le  Groupe ARES  et la  Fondation Accenture  (leader mondial des métiers du conseil), dont l’ambition est d’offrir un emploi et un accompagnement social adaptés aux personnes éloignées de l’emploi. Acces, Inclusive Tech dispose d’un  double agrément d’Entreprise d’Insertion et Entreprise Adaptée . Dans le cadre de son développement, Acces, Inclusive Tech a eu le privilège de travailler avec des entreprises partenaires (grands comptes et des administrations en direct ou via des ESN partenaires) qui partagent son engagement. Depuis sa création en 2016, Acces, Inclusive Tech fournit à ses clients des  prestations numériques  :    Test informatique  Support utilisateur  Helpdesk  Data  Assistance en gestion de projet informatique     Le Groupe Ares vous invite à rejoindre l’équipe d’Acces, Inclusive Tech en tant que    Manager Opérationnel.le Numérique et Inclusion F/H. Votre rôle : les accompagner au quotidien dans leur prise en compétences et l’acquisition de savoir-être professionnels. Vi utvikler regelverk og standarder som gjelder for alle veieiere i Norge, og gjennom vårt arbeid med trafikanter og kjøretøy, ny teknologi og digitale tjenester, sørger vi for at både folk og næringsliv har tilgang til enkle, effektive, trygge og miljøvennlige transportmuligheter.  Statens vegvesen består av to forvaltningsnivåer - et direktorat og seks landsdekkende divisjoner, som sammen jobber for å gjøre veiene våre bedre for alle.  Divisjon Trafikant og kjøretøy (TK) har ansvar for det meste av det som har med førerkort og kjøretøy å gjøre i dette landet. Vi utvikler regelverket innen våre fagfelt og kontrollerer at dette blir fulgt av trafikanter, bileiere, verksteder, trafikkskoler og transportbedrifter. Vi har rundt 1400 ansatte over hele landet og møter publikum hver dag, både fysisk, i telefonen og digitalt. Våre digitale selvbetjeningsløsninger gjør at vi er tilgjengelig hele tiden.  Vi jobber hver dag for at ingen skal bli drept eller hardt skadd i trafikken.  Om stillingen  Vil du lede og utvikle en avdeling med kontakt med innbyggere og næringsliv hver dag? Som avdelingsdirektør for Brukertjenester får du ansvar for en landsdekkende avdeling med 300 ansatte fordelt på 72 trafikkstasjoner.  Avdelingen hjelper kundene våre med spørsmål om førerkort og kjøretøy på trafikkstasjonene og via telefon, e-post og chat. Dette krever god dialog med avdelingene som har ansvar for regelverket på disse områdene.  Du har ansvar for å organisere arbeidet slik at avdelingen møter kundenes behov på en effektiv måte, og for å sikre at medarbeiderne har kompetansen de trenger. Brukertjenester er ofte folks første møte med Statens vegvesen, og har derfor en viktig rolle som vårt ansikt utad. I 2024 fikk vi prisen for beste offentlige kundeservice. For å videreutvikle og profesjonalisere tjenestene våre må du bruke innsikt om blant annet kundehenvendelser, tidsbruk og hvordan oppgavene blir løst.  Statens vegvesen tilbyr stadig flere digitale tjenester, og Brukertjenester har en sentral rolle i å veilede både privatpersoner og profesjonelle kunder, særlig innen kjøretøyområdet.  Arbeidsted er ved hovedkontoret for Trafikant og kjøretøy i Arendal. Andre arbeidssteder hvor vi har kontorsted kan også vurderes, med unntak av Helsfyr kotorsted i Oslo. Patients spend far more time at home than they do in the clinic, but providers have limited visibility into what happens after the patient leaves. At the same time, clinicians spend significant time on documentation, administrative work, and reimbursement.     PhyxUp uses AI to connect the clinical visit with ongoing care. We help patients stay engaged with their treatment at home while automating repetitive clinical and reimbursement workflows for providers.     We’re not just building another healthcare software tool. We’re building the infrastructure for how care continues after the visit.      About the Role   The Business Operations Manager will help keep PhyxUp's business running smoothly as we grow across Korea and the U.S.     You'll work closely with the CEO and our U.S. team to coordinate daily operations, support our clinical and billing teams, manage administrative processes, and keep important projects moving forward.     This is a hands-on role that involves a wide range of responsibilities, from coordinating with U.S. team members and managing operational documents to supporting government programs, finance, HR, and internal projects.     As the company grows, you'll also help improve existing processes and build more efficient systems that allow our team to scale.     Your main responsibility is to make sure our day-to-day operations run smoothly and help build the systems we need as we grow. title: HR Supervisor
description: We are seeking an HR Supervisor to serve as the company's sole human resources professional, with responsibility for the full employee lifecycle from recruitment and onboarding through compliance, payroll inputs, employee relations, and exit.  The company employs a large, predominantly expatriate workforce of tradesmen and technicians alongside engineers and administrative staff, so the role requires strong, hands-on command of Saudi labour law, government platforms, work permit and residency processes, and Saudization requirements — including both Nitaqat and the engineering-profession Saudization ratio.  This is an operational, self-directed role suited to a professional who has run HR in a contracting environment rather than administered it in a large corporate function.       Key Accountabilities     Recruitment & Onboarding  Manage recruitment for all levels, from tradesmen and foremen to engineers and administrative staff. Coordinate overseas recruitment of tradesmen, including visa issuance, recruitment agency management, and arrival processing. Screen, shortlist, and coordinate interviews; prepare offer letters within approved budgets. Deliver structured onboarding, including contracts, medical insurance enrolment, and site safety induction.   Government Platforms & Compliance  Manage all transactions on Qiwa, Muqeem, GOSI, Mudad, and related government platforms. Ensure employment contracts are documented and authenticated on the relevant platforms. Track and renew residency permits, work permits, and medical insurance before expiry; process exit/re-entry and final exit visas. Ensure every employee is registered in GOSI under an accurate occupational title and wage.   Saudization Management  Monitor the Nitaqat band continuously and forecast the impact of every hire and exit before it occurs. Monitor the engineering-profession Saudization ratio; verify that each Saudi engineer meets the minimum registered wage and holds professional accreditation. Advise management on hiring sequence to avoid band deterioration during transitions. Identify and apply for available government employment support programmes.   Payroll Inputs & Employee Records  Prepare monthly payroll inputs covering attendance, overtime, leave, deductions, and new joiners and leavers. Maintain complete personnel files, both physical and digital, for all employees. Calculate end-of-service settlements, leave balances, and ticket entitlements in line with labour law and company policy.   Employee Relations & Discipline  Administer disciplinary procedures and grievance handling in accordance with Saudi labour law and company regulations. Represent the company in labour disputes and coordinate with legal advisors where needed. Monitor labour accommodation standards and address welfare issues affecting the trade workforce.    Policies, Performance & Development  Draft and maintain HR policies, including leave, overtime, attendance, and disciplinary rules.

title: Interface Manager
description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. About The Opportunity   Lead the management of internal and external project interfaces across a major water infrastructure programme entering its close-out phase. Working closely with contractors, consultants, client stakeholders, commissioning teams, and operations representatives, you will be responsible for coordinating the resolution of outstanding interface issues, ensuring alignment between project parties, and driving successful completion, handover, and operational readiness activities. Maintain and manage the project interface register, ensuring all actions, dependencies, and risks are tracked through to closure.   Coordinate interface meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagements to facilitate timely decision-making and issue resolution.   Drive the resolution of outstanding technical, construction, commissioning, and operational interface issues affecting project completion and handover.   Ensure interface requirements are incorporated into commissioning plans, operational readiness activities, and handover strategies.   Monitor contractor performance relating to interface deliverables and completion milestones.   Collaborate with engineering, construction, commercial, HSE, project controls, GIS/BIM, and commissioning teams to ensure alignment across project functions.   Identify, assess, and mitigate interface-related risks that could impact project delivery, commissioning, or handover.   Support the review and coordination of handover documentation, asset information, and operational acceptance requirements.   Provide regular interface status updates, risk assessments, and recommendations to project leadership and client stakeholders. title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

title: Founding Marketing Lead
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

The Opportunity

Lumai is moving from breakthrough optical-compute research to production AI systems. We need an engineer to build the performance and power modelling capability that guides architecture and compiler decisions before silicon exists, helping us turn a working system into a competitive product.

The Role

You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai’s photonic AI hardware will perform against real inference workloads. Your models will give architecture and compiler teams a shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across hardware configurations.

The hard part is balancing speed, fidelity and usability: you will model concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency at enough detail to support decisions, while keeping simulations fast enough to compare configurations in minutes. You will characterise operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results so the model stays grounded in evidence.

By month six, you will have established a reliable modelling flow for priority workloads and device configurations, demonstrated a clear path for closing gaps between model and hardware, and made the simulator a tool that architecture and compiler teams use to make decisions. You will report to the Head of Architecture or VP Engineering and may build and lead a small team around this capability.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships.

  • Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces,

Für unser Technik-Team suchen wir einen AV & IT Engineer (m/w/d), mit mindestens 4 Jahren praktischer Erfahrung, der die integrierten Technologieumgebungen verwaltet, nach Protokoll betreibt sowie per Remote-Support mit unserem japanischen Partner wartet und kalibriert.

In dieser Rolle schlägst Du die Brücke zwischen klassischer AVL-Technik und moderner IT-Infrastruktur. Du betreust plattformübergreifende Betriebssysteme wie Windows und macOS, AV-Netzwerkswitches und fortschrittliche Display- sowie interaktive Technologien, einschließlich High-End-Projektoren von Epson und LiDAR-Sensoren.
Du hast Freude daran, komplexe technische Herausforderungen zu lösen und sorgst für eine nahtlose Konnektivität. Für die Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen und internationalen Teams bringst Du sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit.

Aufgaben

1. AVL- & Interaktive Systemtechnik

  • Technischer Betrieb und Überwachung der AVL Anlagen der neu gebauten Museums
  • Projektorkalibrierung: Wartung von professionellen Projektoren inklusive Edge-Blending, Projection Mapping und Geometriekorrektur
  • Sensortechnologie: Support und Fehlerbehebung von Sensorik für interaktive Installationen, Tracking-Systeme oder räumliche Anwendungen

  • Signalfluss-Optimierung: Fehleranalyse und Sicherstellung der Kommunikation zwischen Sensoren, Medienservern und Display-Hardware

title: Enhetschef Kundenhet Hjälpmedelsverksamheterna
description: Hjälpmedelsverksamheterna ansvarar för drift av hjälpmedelsverksamhet för personer med rörelsehinder i södra delen av Stockholms län samt länsövergripande ansvar för personer med behov av förbrukningshjälpmedel i hemmet,  medicinteknisk apparatur i hemmet samt kommunikations-, kognitions-, syn- och hörselhjälpmedel.    Vi söker dig som är en engagerad och trygg enhetschef till vår kundenhet, där mötet med människor står i centrum. Här får du möjlighet att leda en verksamhet som har en viktig roll i att skapa en välfungerade hjälpmedelsverksamhet för patienter och förskrivare i Region Stockholm.            Beskrivning     Som enhetschef leder du medarbetare som varje dag har kontakt med patienter, anhöriga och förskrivare. Genom ett nära och tydligt ledarskap skapar du goda förutsättningar för en god service, hög kvalitet och professionellt bemötande i varje kontakt.    Vi söker dig som trivs i en verksamhet där människor, utveckling och samhällsnytta möts. Hos oss har du möjlighet att påverka, utveckla och göra skillnad, både för patienter och de medarbetare du leder. Du har förmåga att både se helhet och detaljer med fokus på att skapa en verksamhet med hög kvalitet.    Du har personal-, arbetsmiljö- och budgetansvar och ingår i verksamhetens ledningsgrupp. Du arbetar nära andra chefer och bidrar aktivt till gemensam styrning, utveckling och planering.     Kvalifikationer     Erfarenhet av chefs eller ledaruppdrag, gärna med personal och arbetsmiljöansvar. Erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla kund/patientnära verksamhet. Du har en god förståelse för patienters behov och perspektiv och vikten av ett professionellt bemötande. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga.    Erfarenhet från hjälpmedelsverksamhet, hälso- och sjukvård eller annan offentlig verksamhet.    Kunskap om förskrivningsprocess och förskrivares förutsättningar.     Personliga egenskaper     Trygg i ditt ledarskap.    Lyhörd och kommunikativ.    Lösningsorienterad, ser möjligheter snarare än hinder.    Du är strukturerad och kan prioritera när det är många frågor samtidigt.    Har ett genuint intresse för service och kvalitet.     Villkor     Du kommer att erbjudas en tillsvidareanställning i grundbefattning med ett treårigt förordnande som enhetschef.    Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för intern omplacering, enligt gällande regelverk.     Vid patientnära arbete inom Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde:      - tillämpas registerkontroll före beslut om anställning enligt SLSO:s övergripande anvisning för registerkontroll vid anställning.     - ska medarbetare som kommer att ha patientkontakt genomgå nyanställningsundersökning, enligt gällande direktiv, vilket sker genom företagshälsovården innan anställning.     - krävs, förutom svensk yrkeslegitimation, goda kunskaper i svenska språket motsvarande nivå C1 enligt den gemensamma europeiska referensramen (GERS). Samma krav är vägledande vad gäller icke-legitimerad personal med patientkontakt.

title: Enhetschef till Avfall
description: Om arbetsplatsen   Vi är en viktig samhällsbyggare som levererar effektiva och hållbara vatten- och avfallstjänster – för dagens och framtida stockholmare. Varje dag, året runt, förser vi 1,6 miljoner stockholmare med rent och gott kranvatten, renar avloppsvatten och ser till att avfallet tas om hand. Tillsammans med invånare, företag och andra intressenter arbetar vi för att Stockholm ska bli världens mest hållbara stad.   Arbetsuppgifter   Avfallsverksamheten i Stockholm har en miljon kunder och en verksamhet som engagerar. Uppdraget innebär att hantera det kommunala ansvaret för avfallshantering i en offentligt styrd verksamhet. Vi söker nu en engagerad och operativ enhetschef till enheten Samordning. Enheten har ett brett uppdrag med fokus på kundnära frågor vilket bland annat omfattar rådgivning till kund om avfallslösningar, information och dialog om avfallshantering, implementering av lagförändringar och insamlingssystem samt utredning och hantering av kundärenden. Inom enhetens uppdrag återfinns även drift och underhåll av stadens 250 återvinningsstationer.  Här får du möjlighet att tillsammans med 13 medarbetare utveckla arbetssätt och processer i syfte att skapa effektiva lösningar för kunder och utveckla vårt kundbemötande. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering på huvudkontoret i Ulvsunda, Bromma.  Inom enhetens uppdrag ligger bland annat:     Rådgivning om avfallslösningar   Informations- och kommunikationsinsatser om avfallshantering   Samordning och fördelning av kundärenden   Samordning och implementering av nya lagkrav och ansvar   Utredning och hantering av kundärenden och kundbestridanden   Drift, underhåll och skötsel av återvinningsstationer samt att säkerställa erforderliga tillstånd kopplat till dessa   Upphandlingar, avtalsförvaltning och entreprenörsrelationer   Uppdrag inom avfallsförvaltningen enligt delegation     Kvalifikationer   Vi söker dig som är kund- och resultatorienterad, med förmåga att omvandla analyser till konkreta förbättringar i metoder och arbetssätt. Du har ett helhetsperspektiv och god förmåga att leda, samordna och implementera utveckling. Olemme aidosti ylpeitä liiketoimintamme jalommasta tarkoituksesta, jonka myötä olemme omistajamme kautta jo vuosikymmenten ajan tukeneet lasten ja nuorten urheilua ja hyvinvointia valtakunnallisesti.   Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset Haemme valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen palvelupäällikköä, joka osallistuu niin asiakkuuden ohjausryhmätyöskentelyyn kuin kentän operatiiviseen toimintaan. Osaat johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti sekä tukea esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Hallitset työssä tarvittavat järjestelmät ja hyödynnät tietoa toiminnan seurannassa, raportoinnissa, päätöksenteossa ja kehittämisessä. Varmistat palvelun laadun, sovittujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen ja arjen sujuvuuden yli yksikkörajojen. Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan

description:

  About Orchard  
 'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract.  
 We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands. 
 This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time. 
 The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires. 
  
  About the role  
 What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed. You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet. 
 This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell. 
  Requirements  
 
 You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native.  
 You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change. 
 You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive. 
 You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell. 
 Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies. 
 You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one. 
 
  Benefits  
 
 £65,000 - £95,000 base + commission 
 Unlimited PTO 
 6% pension contribution 
 Travel budget for meetings, US trips included 
 Remote first, with a London desk when you want one

Die collana health AG fungiert als digitales Kompetenzzentrum für das schweizerische Gesundheitswesen. Wir begleiten Spitäler, Kliniken und Gesundheitsinstitutionen in allen Phasen der Digitalisierung – von strategischer Beratung über Prozessoptimierung bis zur Implementierung und zum Betrieb von IT-Lösungen. title: Senior Security Assurance Specialist
description:
Location: Office First - Berlin

Team description

Our security assurance team keeps SumUp's information security programme credible, both to regulators and to the millions of merchants who trust us with their business. As part of a small global team spanning Europe, Brazil and Chile, you'll help translate frameworks like ISO 27001, PCI DSS and NIST into practical controls that hold up under real audits and real third-party scrutiny. This is a chance to shape how a fast-growing fintech proves its security maturity across multiple regulatory environments at once, with real ownership over the areas you improve.

What you'll do

  • Review information security controls, audit findings and risk mitigation plans, working with other teams to put the right fixes in place
  • Run third-party due diligence, supplier reviews and contract assessments as part of the third-party risk management process
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to promote strong security practices and help embed security principles into their day-to-day processes
  • Support external and internal audits and due diligence requests, responding directly to auditors, clients and partners
  • Track relevant laws, regulations and security standards, flagging gaps against SumUp's existing controls
  • Help maintain and improve the team's security maturity picture, identifying priority areas and leading or supporting initiatives to close them

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Experience reviewing and improving information security controls in a similar assurance or GRC-focused role
  • Strong knowledge of information security standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST, plus payment security standards like PCI DSS
  • Comfort working with third party risk management and audit procedures, including supplier and contract reviews
  • Ability to prioritise and simplify complex, sometimes ambiguous request

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
Team description

The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day. This role owns the Engagement domain — covering merchant engagement, product activation, support responses, and navigation across the SuperApp and web dashboard — and is the primary analytics partner for the Engagement product team. It's a genuine opportunity to take full ownership of a domain, build the measurement foundations from the ground up, and shift the team from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-led decision-making.

What you'll do

  • Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one

  • Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions

  • Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders

  • Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst

  • Partner with product managers to develop and map out KPI trees, identify measurement gaps, and improve the quality and accuracy of engagement tracking across the domain

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

StartSteps offers intensive bootcamps to equip aspiring professionals with skills and knowledge to transition into a new technical career. As part of these bootcamp programs, the learners are required to participate in a series of Job Readiness sessions intended to prepare them for a career in the German job market and support them in their job search.

We are about to launch a new SAP training program focused on Procurement and Sales and are currently in search of a part-time Trainer, a crucial role focused on the delivery and teaching of this Job Readiness series. This role will deliver a Job Readiness Series of sessions in English for international talent entering the German market. The series will be delivered to cohorts of mid-career professionals.

We have multiple cohorts planned for the 2027 calendar year, so this role could be responsible for delivering multiple series of sessions concurrently, up to roughly 20 hours per week. Trainings occur one to two days per week Monday-Friday from 9am-6pm.

Tasks

  • Manage multiple course curriculums, in total delivering 1-2 full-day training sessions per week.
  • Teach courses on employability topics: including: CVs for Germany, interviews, job searching, using LinkedIn; and soft skills topics including: conflict management, problem solving, teamwork, communication and workplace culture.
  • Focus advice on German hiring norms.
  • Give structured feedback to students and set short challenges.
  • Prepare a short weekly outcomes update.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Germany in HR/recruiting, coaching or hiring partnerships.
  • Proven facilitation skills in a field related to job readiness or employability.
  • Strong portfolio of relevant training materials or guides.
  • Fluent in English as well as strong German skills.
  • Reliable setup for live session delivery.
  • Available starting from January 2027.

title: Palvelupäällikkö, Ajoneuvokorvaukset-yksikkö, LähiTapiola Vakuutusliiketoiminnan palvelut
description: Haluatko olla rakentamassa tulevaisuuden palveluorganisaatiota omistaja-asiakkaidemme elämän turvaamiseksi? Innostaako sinua arvostava ihmisten johtaminen, muutoksen läpivienti ja palveluiden kehittäminen? Tule viemään kanssamme elämänturvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja tekemään merkityksellistä työtä yrityskulttuurissa, jossa tärkein kivijalka on hyvinvoiva ja osaava henkilöstö.       Olemme perustamassa vuoden 2027 alusta uutta tiimiä Vaasaan osaksi Ajoneuvokorvaukset-yksikköämme. Etsimme nyt tiimille suunnannäyttäjäksi osaavaa palvelupäällikköä.       Tehtävä on uusi ja pääset siinä rakentamaan tiimisi osaksi valtakunnallista, kehittyvää ajoneuvokorvausten kokonaisuutta — kokeneen johtotiimin ja kollegajoukon tuella. Palvelupäällikkönä olet paitsi tiimisi korvausneuvojien esihenkilö, myös yksikkömme johtotiimin jäsen. Tärkeimmät tehtäväsi ovat valmentava esihenkilötyö, arjen onnistumisten edellytyksien luominen, palveluidemme kehittäminen sekä paikallisen yhteistyön vieminen seuraavalle tasolle.      Tiimisi korvausneuvojat työskentelevät ajoneuvo- ja venevahinkojen parissa kaikissa palvelukanavissamme. Työskentelemme yksikössämme monipaikkaisesti: osa oman tiimisi korvausneuvojista työskentelee Vaasan lisäksi muilla Länsi-Suomen alueen paikkakunnilla, esimerkiksi Porissa. Lähimmät kollegasi ovat Tampereella, Kuopiossa ja Espoossa.     Sinulle on keskeistä viedä tiimisi kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita omalla esimerkilläsi. Tärkeä tehtäväsi on myös tukea henkilöstömme hyvinvointia, vahvistaa yhtenäisiä toimintamalleja sekä rakentaa myönteistä tekemisen kulttuuria. Olet onnistunut tehtävässä, kun uusi Vaasan tiimimme löytää paikkansa osana valtakunnallista ajoneuvokorvausten kokonaisuutta, arjen johtaminen on selkeää, tiimisi korvausneuvojat onnistuvat tuellasi työssään ja yhteistyömme paikallisen alueyhtiön kanssa on mutkatonta ja sujuvaa.     Yksikön johtotiimin jäsenenä osallistut yksikkömme palveluiden ja prosessien kehittämiseen sekä arvostavan, aktiivisen ja tavoitteellisen johtamiskulttuurin rakentamiseen. Painotamme kykyä ennakoida ja halua toimia muuttuvassa maailmassa sekä innostaa muita mukaan. Kannustamme esihenkilöitä osallistavaan ja valmentavaan johtamiseen     Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää matkustamista ja säännöllistä, viikoittaista läsnäoloa tiimiläistesi työskentelypaikkakunnilla sekä valmiutta liikkua myös yksikkömme muilla sijaintipaikkakunnilla.      Toivomme sinulta    Vankkaa kokemusta valmentavasta ja tuloksellisesta esihenkilötyöstä sekä konkreettisia näyttöjä muutosjohtamisesta asiakaspalveluorganisaatiossa  Innostusta ja kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen sekä prosessien kehittämiseen  Halua erinomaisen asiakaspalvelun tuottamiseen korvauspalvelussa  Tavoitteellista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työskentelytapaa sekä hyvää paineensietokykyä  Erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä verkostoitumistaitoa  Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista  Tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa       A

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description: We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager – Finland (CRM & Content) to drive user engagement and, most importantly, grow the share of paying subscribers.  This is a highly hands-on role sitting across two equally important areas: CRM & lifecycle marketing and content operations.     On the CRM side, you’ll own the customer journey from single-ticket purchase to subscription, as well as onboarding, engagement and retention. You’ll build and optimise campaigns and automations across email, mobile and onsite channels, with success measured by subscriber growth, conversion and retention – not just opens and clicks.     On the content side, you’ll be the operational hub connecting agencies, creators, influencers and internal teams. You’ll ensure content moves efficiently from production through adaptation to campaign-ready assets across paid, CRM, social and brand channels.     This is not a purely strategic marketing role. We’re looking for someone who enjoys getting into the tools, building campaigns, managing content, speaking to customers and making things happen.     CRM & Lifecycle Marketing   Build, launch and optimise CRM automations and manual campaigns across email, mobile and onsite messaging.  Own the single-ticket-to-subscriber conversion journey, alongside onboarding and renewal.  Manage weekly and recurring campaigns end-to-end – from copy and design through build, QA and send.  Own segmentation, targeting and campaign optimisation.  Measure performance against subscriber conversion, active subscribers and churn.      Content & Agency Management      Own the end-to-end content pipeline from production agencies through adaptation to channel-ready assets.  Brief, manage and QA external agencies, ensuring quality, consistency and deadlines.  Coordinate assets across paid, CRM, social and brand channels.  Manage timelines, versions and channel-specific requirements.      Creators, Influencers & Social      Source, brief, contract and manage content creators and influencers.  Manage usage rights and ensure creator content can be used across the wider advertising pipeline.  Track performance and use learnings to improve future partnerships.  Own the social content calendar and day-to-day community management.  Monitor and respond to comments and direct messages while actively growing the community. Support the VP with brand campaigns, partnerships, OOH and other above-the-line activity.      You’ll ideally bring:      5+ years of B2C marketing experience, with hands-on CRM/lifecycle ownership.  Experience building automations and campaigns yourself within a modern CRM/marketing automation platform.  A proven track record of using CRM to increase paying customers, subscribers or revenue.  Experience managing external agencies and multi-stage content production workflows.  Experience managing content creators and/or influencer partnerships, including contracting and performance tracking.  Excellent Finnish copywriting

title: CRM Manager
description: Bras droit du Head of E-commerce sur la réinternalisation complète du CRM (Klaviyo, Wax, Recharge). Tu construis les flows de zéro (welcome, post-achat, panier abandonné, win-back, réactivation abonnés), conçois ses templates dans Figma, pilote la segmentation, les A/B tests et le reporting hebdo.  Sur Recharge, tu travailles la rétention : relances, upgrades, réduction du churn.     Audit et refonte des flows Klaviyo  : welcome series, post-achat, panier abandonné, win-back, réactivation abonnés, construits de zéro, pas de template repris.     Conception des templates emails dans Figma  et intégration dans Klaviyo.     Pilotage de la segmentation et des A/B tests  sur l'ensemble des flows.     Gestion du planning éditorial  et reporting hebdomadaire sur ce qui progresse réellement.     Optimisation de la rétention sur Recharge  : relances intelligentes, upgrades de formule, réduction du churn.     Exploitation de la donnée client  pour personnaliser les campagnes, pas pour remplir des slides.     Suivi des KPIs clés  : abonnés actifs Recharge, LTV 12 mois, repeat rate, open rate et CVR des flows.          Télétravail 1 jours / semaine    Tickets restaurants    Compléments alimentaires (100€/mois)    Espace Sauna           + de 3 ans d'expérience sur un poste CRM ou e-commerce, en environnement DTC ou DNVB. Tu as idéalement évolué dans l'univers des compléments alimentaires, de la santé, de la beauté ou du sport, tu connais les codes de ce marché et les contraintes réglementaires qui vont avec.    maîtrises Klaviyo de bout en bout : tu construis des flows de zéro, tu sais lire un rapport de délivrabilité, tu segmentes finement au-delà des critères évidents. Tu es autonome sur Figma, tu conçois tes templates toi-même et tu les intègres proprement.    Tu as déjà géré un outil d'abonnement type Recharge. Tu sais ce qui fait bouger un taux de rétention et tu ne traites pas un client qui suspend comme un client qui résilie.    Tu connais le produit que tu portes. Tu ne pousses pas un email générique, tu construis une offre pertinente pour le bon segment, au bon moment.    Tu penses en hypothèses, tu testes, tu valides par la donnée. Un taux qui stagne te dérange, et tu sais quoi faire pour le bouger.    Tu es à l'aise en petite structure. Tu prends des décisions sans attendre trois validations, et tu reportes ce qui avance vraiment, pas ce qui fait bien sur un slide.    Une bonne connaissance de Shopify et du parcours client est un plus : elle t'aide à envoyer chaque flow vers la bonne page. Et si tu t'intéresses concrètement à ce que l'IA peut apporter dans une stratégie CRM, encore mieux.             Etape 1 : questionnaire    Etape 2 : head of E-com + fondateur    Etape 3 : fondateur 2    Etape 4: RH

title: Responsable Relation Client Pro (F/H)
description: Notre mission ? Accompagner chacun à créer des habitats qui rendent la vie meilleure.  Castorama, c’est d'abord une aventure humaine, une équipe engagée de commerçants spécialistes conquérants répartis dans 93 magasins en France.  Depuis plus de 55 ans, nos 11 000 collègues partagent un objectif commun : faire de nos clients, des clients très satisfaits. Une ambition portée par des valeurs fortes : la passion de servir, l’audace, la responsabilité et l’esprit d’équipe.   Ici, chacun a son rôle à jouer . Tu commences quand ?    Missions     Tu développes et animes le portefeuille de clients PRO par des actions de recrutement et de fidélisation. Garant(e) de l’activité PRO, tu coordonnes l’ensemble des opérations en magasin afin d’améliorer l’expérience d’achat de nos clients PRO et accroître la performance.    Pour Ce Faire, Tu     Garantis une relation privilégiée avec les clients PRO, en répondant à leurs besoins et en promouvant le programme de fidélité  Proposes les services adaptés aux besoins client PRO, gères les ventes et devis et assures également le service après-vente  Développes et animes le portefeuille client PRO, identifies les opportunités et organises des actions commerciales ciblées  Pilotes les indicateurs commerciaux et mets en place des plans d’action  Assures l’animation du programme PRO en magasin, formes les équipes et mets en visibilité le programme pro dans le parcours client  Manages l’équipe PRO en magasin  Es en veille sur le marché des pros et es force de proposition sur les actions à mener      Profil      Ta connaissance et ta curiosité pour le marché des PRO  Ton expérience réussie dans le domaine des PRO  Ta passion de servir et ton sens du service client  Ton leadership et ta capacité à animer les équipes  Ton aisance relationnelle, ta rigueur et ton organisation  Ton goût du challenge et ton orientation résultats    En magasin, tu bénéficies d’avantages tels que la mutuelle et la prévoyance, les offres du Comité Social et Economique, et des espaces de détente.  Au-delà de trois mois de présence, tu profiteras également de tickets restaurant et d’une carte de réduction sur les produits vendus en magasin.   Rejoindre notre magasin, c’est aussi intégrer une équipe soudée et motivée avec qui tu pourras partager ton dynamisme et ta bonne humeur !

title: Client Success Manager (CSM-1)
description: Job Type  Full-time   Description   The Client Success Manager is responsible for developing customer relationships that promote growth and retention. The job is to work closely with customers to ensure they are satisfied with the services they receive and to improve upon areas of dissatisfaction. To be successful, the CSM must have an in-depth knowledge of company products, services, partner integrations, client business practices and possess effective communication skills with a genuine desire to understand the client’s business and provide value through actionable insights. Ability to handle multiple, critical, high-priority issues with a sense of urgency.  Proficiency with Google Suite Products.  Excellent communication—verbal, written, interpersonal with strong active listening skills.  Ability to demonstrate effective problem-solving skills and strong client orientation.  Detail-oriented and dependable, with a positive and inquisitive attitude.  Ability to multitask, prioritize, and collaborate cross-functionally.  Exhibit a high degree of self-motivation, drive, and a proactive nature.  A track record of providing excellent customer advocacy.     Education And Experience     Bachelor's degree.  3-5 years of experience in a customer success role.  Real Estate industry experience (preferred). title: Customer Success Manager
description: Qui sommes-nous ?    Koala Interactive est une société à taille humaine en forte croissance, en charge de Wyylde, le réseau social qui permet d’explorer la diversité des pratiques sexuelles, dans un cadre sécurisé. Leader en France depuis 2016, Wyylde totalise plus de 7 millions d'inscrits et 700 000 visites par jour. Après l'acquisition réussie de NSF (Nuit Sans Folie) en 2020, et notre expansion en Italie, Espagne et Allemagne, nous cherchons à renforcer notre équipe avec des talents passionnés pour poursuivre notre aventure internationale.    Nos valeurs :  Liberté, Respect, Responsabilité. Elles ne sont pas de simples mots, mais le fondement de notre culture d'entreprise.   Chez Koala Interactive, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler dans un environnement qui valorise votre créativité et autonomie, tout en respectant votre équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle grâce au télétravail.    Rôle    Le/la Customer Success Manager est garant.e de la performance et de la conformité de l'ensemble de notre dispositif de support et de modération, en pilotant à la fois les équipes internes et notre prestataire externe.    Ton obsession :  coacher et motiver ton équipe au quotidien afin d'assurer la satisfaction de nos utilisateurs, tout en garantissant que nos processus de modération restent conformes aux exigences réglementaires applicables (règlement sur les services numériques, Arcom).   Tu es également garant.e de l'amélioration continue des processus de traitement des demandes utilisateurs et de modération de contenus.   Last but not least : tu portes la voix du client à travers l'organisation et particulièrement auprès de l'équipe Produit pour intégrer à notre roadmap les demandes et suggestions des utilisateurs.    Missions et Responsabilités       Garantir la qualité du service  fourni par les équipes internes et notre prestataire externe afin de satisfaire nos utilisateurs   Être garant.e de la  conformité juridique  de notre dispositif de modération au regard du règlement sur les services numériques (RSN/DSA) et des exigences de l'Arcom : mise à jour des procédures, traçabilité des décisions, coordination avec la Direction Juridique   Superviser la  chaîne d’escalade des demandes et signalements , notamment les cas complexes, sensibles ou présentant un enjeu juridique, et coordonner si nécessaire les signalements aux autorités compétentes.   Définir, structurer et améliorer en continu les  processus de support et de modération  afin d'accompagner la croissance et le développement international de Wyylde.    Garantir la performance opérationnelle du service client  (délai de première réponse, taux de résolution au premier contact, délai de résolution) dans 6 langues, avec une couverture 24/7   Réaliser des bilans mensuels sur le niveau de qualité de service délivré et animer le comité de pilotage avec notre prestataire   Contribuer au déploiement et à l'atteinte des  objectifs qualité fixés , et assurer le suivi des indicateurs

title: Customer Incident Manager
description: The role & its impact  When incidents happen, every second counts. You'll be the key orchestrator managing major and minor incidents from the customer's perspective—working across teams to find solutions fast and keep everyone informed. You'll balance immediate crisis response with strategic problem-solving, ensuring customers experience minimal disruption and have clarity on what's happening and why.  You'll own incident management end-to-end: from investigation and impact assessment through to post-incident reviews and recommendations that prevent problems from happening again. You'll build the systems and processes that help teams respond confidently and reduce incidents before they occur, making you instrumental in building customer trust.  The team & how they connect  The incident management team works at the heart of Xero's customer operations, coordinating across engineering, product, support, and leadership to respond to issues that affect our customers. They're problem-solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, bringing rigour and human empathy to every incident response. The team collaborates across geographic regions and departments, treating every issue as an opportunity to strengthen Xero's resilience.  The team is currently working on / Initially, the role may focus on    Building and refining incident management processes and incident registers to prevent issues before they occur  Managing customer-facing communications during incidents to keep stakeholders informed and reassured  Coordinating cross-functional teams to implement both short-term fixes and long-term solutions  Post-incident reviews and recommendations that help reduce recurrence    Where and how you can work  This role has a hybrid working arrangement of 3 days working from our offices and 2 days working from home.  Here are some of the things we are looking for    You'll bring strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to make informed decisions and lead teams through high-pressure situations toward resolution.  You'll thrive on building relationships and collaborating effectively—your ability to influence across all levels and challenge assumptions respectfully makes you a natural leader in complex situations.  You'll demonstrate a genuine customer service mentality, ensuring every decision prioritises minimising customer impact and keeping them informed with clarity.  You'll bring proven experience managing major incidents or complex issues, alongside a track record of leading projects to successful delivery outcomes.  You'll Go Together by coordinating specialist teams across regions and bringing the right people to the table to solve problems—comfortable working autonomously but knowing when to collaborate.  You'll Go Fast by ship ideas, test solutions, and improve them—taking initiative and pushing forward in fast-paced, high-profile environments without waiting for perfect clarity.     Apply even if your experience isn't

title: Kenttähuollon tiiminvetäjä, Drives Operations, Motion Service
description: ABB :llä pääset mukaan auttamaan eri teollisuudenaloja toimimaan tuottavammin, tehokkaammin ja kestävämmin.  Meillä sinua rohkaistaan viemään asioita eteenpäin, saat tukea ja mahdollisuuksia kasvaa ja olla ylpeä siitä, mitä saavutamme yhdessä.  Tule mukaan rakentamaan kestävämpää tulevaisuutta. Run what runs the world.   Tämä Positio Raportoi   Drives Service Operations Manager  __   Työnkuvasi ja vastuualueesi   Etsimme ABB Motion Services -divisioonaan kenttähuollon tiiminvetäjää Drives Operations -tiimiin. Motion Servicessä työskentelee 150 ammattilaista eri puolilla Suomea. Olemme johtava asiantuntija taajuusmuuttajien, moottoreiden ja generaattoreiden elinkaaripalveluissa.  Toimit ABB:n taajuusmuuttajien kenttähuoltotiimin esihenkilönä. Tiimissäsi työskentelee kokeneita asiantuntijoita, ja sinulla sekä tiimilläsi on tärkeä rooli laadukkaan huoltotoiminnan tuottamisessa ja asiakastyytyväisyyden varmistamisessa. Teet läheistä yhteistyötä myynti-, operatiivisen- ja solutions -tiimin kanssa asiakkaidemme korkean palvelutason varmistamiseksi. Työskentelet asiantuntijaorganisaatiossa, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan tulevaisuuden palveluliiketoiminnan kehittämiseen.  Tiimissämme viihtyy henkilö, joka innostuu uusista teknologisista ratkaisuista, päivittäisen huoltotoiminnan kehittämisestä sekä uusien mahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta liiketoiminnan kasvun aikaansaamiseksi.  Työpaikka sijaitsee Helsingissä ja edellyttää viikoittaista läsnäoloa Helsingin toimistolla.   Pääasialliset Vastuualueesi     Oman toiminta-alueesi tulosvastuu sisältäen liikevaihto- ja kannattavuustavoitteet  Päivittäisen työn suunnittelu ja organisointi  Asiakasprojektien onnistunut toteutus aikataulussa ja laadukkaasti yhdessä tiimisi kanssa  Henkilöstöjohtaminen ja osaamisen kehittäminen. Johdat ja kehität tiimiäsi valmentavalla otteella. title: Avdelingsleder
description: Som Avdelingsleder Kristiansand får du ansvaret for å lede og videreutvikle en sentral avdeling i et marked med betydelig potensial og strategisk betydning for Cramo. Rollen kombinerer operativ ledelse med et tydelig strategisk ansvar, der du både skal sikre en effektiv daglig drift og bidra til å forme avdelingens videre utvikling og vekst.  Kristiansand er et viktig satsingsområde for Cramo, og som avdelingsleder vil du være tett på beslutningsprosesser som påvirker både den lokale virksomheten og selskapets videre utvikling. Du får totalansvar for avdelingens drift, resultater, medarbeidere, HMS-arbeid og kundeopplevelser, samtidig som du forventes å identifisere nye muligheter og skape langsiktig verdiskaping.  Dette er en rolle for deg som motiveres av å skape resultater gjennom mennesker, bygge sterke relasjoner og utvikle en virksomhet med høye ambisjoner.   Om Stillingen   Ansvarsområder    Lede den daglige driften av avdelingen med ansvar for økonomiske resultater, medarbeidere og HMS.   Sikre høy kundetilfredshet og videreutvikle avdelingens markedsposisjon.   Følge opp budsjetter, KPI-er og gjennomføre nødvendige tiltak for å nå avdelingens mål.   Utvikle og motivere medarbeidere gjennom tydelig ledelse og aktiv oppfølging.   Sikre effektiv ressursutnyttelse og optimalisering av avdelingens maskinpark.  Bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring av arbeidsprosesser, kvalitet og miljøarbeid.   Samarbeide tett med salgsorganisasjonen for å identifisere og realisere vekstmuligheter i markedet.     Hos Cramo får du en sentral lederrolle med stor påvirkningskraft i en virksomhet som skal vokse videre. Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med korte beslutningsveier og høy grad av tillit og ansvar.  Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode utviklingsmuligheter og muligheten til å lede en avdeling som står sentralt i vår videre satsing i Agder. Er du klar for å ta ansvar for videre utvikling av vår virksomhet i Kristiansand? Da ser vi frem til å høre fra deg.  Kombinerer forretningsforståelse med evnen til å skape engasjement og resultater gjennom andre. Du er tydelig, handlekraftig og strukturert, samtidig som du bygger tillit og gode relasjoner til både medarbeidere, kunder og samarbeidspartnere.   Videre Ser Vi Gjerne At Du Har     Ledererfaring med personalansvar.  Erfaring fra drift, logistikk, service- eller produksjonsvirksomhet.  God økonomisk forståelse og erfaring med resultatansvar.  Evne til å arbeide både strategisk og operativt.  Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner.     Bransjeerfaring er en fordel, men ikke avgjørende. Det viktigste er at du er en trygg leder med drivkraft til å utvikle mennesker, prosesser og forretning.   Interessert?   Har du spørsmål om stillingen? Banks, fintechs and AI companies use our infrastructure to access the investment, pension, savings, insurance and loan data their customers choose to share, structured and ready to use. Not because they are careless, but because the answer sits scattered across countless institutions that have never had a reason to put it together. Putting it together is what we do.     It is a tougher challenge than it looks from the outside. Financial data is fragmented, unstandardised and locked inside legacy systems that are different in every market we enter. Reaching it reliably, at the standard a bank will actually sign off on, is the hard part. Every customer we take live is one more financial service built on the full picture instead of a piece of it.     We started in Stockholm in 2018 with insurance data. You are the customer's main point of contact from week one until they are live - when things are going well, and when challenges arise. title: Security Delivery Manager
description: Join Accenture Security and play a key role in strengthening our clients’ cyber defense capabilities.  As a  Cybersecurity Service Delivery Manager , you will lead the delivery of SIEM logging and security monitoring enablement across complex enterprise environments. You will combine strong technical knowledge of SIEM and log management with delivery leadership, ensuring security-relevant data is onboarded, normalized and validated to effectively support threat detection and monitoring use cases.  You will work closely with security, application, infrastructure and engineering teams to translate detection and monitoring requirements into actionable logging requirements, drive structured onboarding waves, resolve data-quality challenges and provide stakeholders with clear visibility of delivery progress, risks and outcomes.  What You’ll Do  SIEM & Logging Delivery    Lead end-to-end delivery of log-source assessment, onboarding and validation into enterprise SIEM platforms, with Splunk preferred.   Define and govern logging requirements aligned with security monitoring, detection and investigation use cases.   Oversee log onboarding activities including source identification, ingestion, parsing, field extraction, normalization and validation.   Assess log sources for quality, completeness, consistency and security value, identifying gaps and recommending remediation.   Ensure required security events and fields are captured accurately and made available to monitoring and detection teams.    Technical & Delivery Leadership    Provide technical direction and troubleshooting support for complex log ingestion, parsing, mapping and data-quality issues.   Apply strong knowledge of common logging formats and protocols, including syslog, JSON, Windows Event Logs and application logs.   Drive consistent approaches to data normalization and standardization across diverse technology environments.   Understand how telemetry supports detection engineering and collaborate with detection teams to ensure logs meet defined use-case requirements.   Coordinate dependencies across application, infrastructure, platform and cybersecurity teams to enable required logging.   Lead delivery through batch-based, wave-based or phased onboarding approaches, balancing delivery priorities, dependencies and technical readiness.    Service Management & Governance    Own delivery planning, progress tracking, risks, issues, dependencies and stakeholder reporting for assigned logging initiatives.   Establish clear quality criteria and ensure onboarding outputs meet agreed technical and operational requirements.   Produce high-quality assessments, onboarding documentation, status reporting and management-level updates.   Facilitate working sessions with technical teams and stakeholders to resolve blockers and maintain delivery momentum.   Identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes, logging standards, operational efficiency and monitoring coverage.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Multiple Domains)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting!

Now we are looking for three experienced Senior Analytics Engineers to join our Analytics Engineering teams. We have three domains available: Consumer, Merchant, or Ads. You can work in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki.

About the role

The role is focused on the business needs - you'll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Mercura (YC W25) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months. With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

About the role

You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked.

That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything.

We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you.

What you will be working on

  • Find the real problem. Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building.

  • Ship it yourself. Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it.

  • Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so.

description:
About SandboxAQ

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. As a Machine Learning Engineer on AQCell, you will build and maintain the models and data infrastructure that power this pipeline.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

  • Own the development of FPGA functions for our electronic warfare and signals intelligence capabilities, from initial architecture to validation on operational hardware.

  • Integrate ADC/DAC interfaces, coordinate transmit and receive timing, and ensure synchronization with the radar front end.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
