About Edwards   Edwards is a leading developer and manufacturer of sophisticated vacuum products, exhaust management systems and related value-added services. Edwards solutions are integral to manufacturing processes for semiconductors, flat panel displays, LEDs and solar cells. They are also used within an increasingly diverse range of industrial processes including power, glass and other coating applications; steel and other metallurgy; pharmaceutical and chemical; and for scientific instruments in a wide range of R&D applications.  Edwards has over 4,000 employees worldwide engaged in the design, manufacture and support of high technology vacuum and exhaust management equipment. Edwards has state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Europe, Asia and North America.

description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 아임웹을 핵심 도구로 사용하고 있는 고객사들이 우리의 파트너입니다. Account Manager는 담당 고객사의 매출 성장과 리텐션을 직접 책임지면서, 동시에 고객사가 아임웹을 더 깊이 활용해 다음 성장을 만들어내도록 돕는 역할입니다. 고객사의 GMV가 곧 우리의 성과 지표이며, 활용 깊이를 만드는 일과 매출을 만드는 일을 한 사람이 함께 책임지기에, 단기 매출과 장기적인 신뢰 관계를 동시에 만들어갈 수 있습니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    담당 고객사 포트폴리오의 매출과 운영 현황, 활용 지표를 분석하여 성장 기회와 이탈 리스크에 대응합니다.  고객사의 비즈니스 단계와 페인포인트에 맞춰 아임웹의 기능과 데이터를 어떻게 더 잘 활용할 수 있을지 제안하고, 정기 미팅을 통해 실행을 지원합니다.  활용도와 비즈니스 확장 시점을 가장 가까이에서 포착해 추가 기능과 서비스 도입을 제안하고, 업셀링과 크로스셀링으로 연결합니다.  이전 고객사의 온보딩을 리드하여, 도입 초기에 아임웹의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 경험하고 자기 비즈니스에 자리잡을 수 있도록 돕습니다.  계약 갱신과 재계약 협상을 직접 리드하며, 장기 파트너십을 통한 리텐션을 책임집니다.  고객사의 VOC와 페인포인트를 구조화해 프로덕트, CX 팀에 전달하며, 제품과 서비스 개선의 브리지 역할을 수행합니다.  잘 성장하고 있는 고객사의 사례를 발굴해 콘텐츠와 레퍼런스로 만들고, 마케팅, 세일즈 팀과 함께 다른 고객사로 확산시킵니다.    [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 Account Manager, Customer Success, 고객 컨설팅 등 고객 접점 직무에서 5년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  다수의 중, 대형 고객 포트폴리오를 운영하며 매출 성장과 리텐션, 업셀링에서 의미 있는 성과를 만들어내신 분  고객사의 비즈니스를 깊이 이해하고, 데이터를 기반으로 컨설팅에 가까운 제안을 해보신 분  Spreadsheet, BI 툴 등으로 직접 데이터를 분석하고, 협상과 제안의 근거로 활용하시는 분  고객사 의사결정자와 신뢰감 있게 소통하고, 다양한 이해관계자와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에 유연하게 적응하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM, 광고 솔루션 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험이 있으신 분  신규 영업의 협상과 계약부터 온보딩, 확장까지 풀 사이클을 경험해보신 분  CRM 또는 BI 툴을 적극적으로 활용해본 경험이 있으신 분  데이터 기반의 업셀링, 크로스셀링 시나리오를 직접 설계해 매출 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분  중형과 대형 고객사를 대상으로 한 정기 비즈니스 리뷰와 컨설팅 운영 경험  활용 데이터를 기반으로 이탈을 예측하거나 확장 기회를 발견해본 경험  D2C 브랜드, 쇼핑몰, 마켓플레이스 등 이커머스 생태계에 대한 깊은 이해       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

title: Lead Account Manager, Enablement Partner
description: Job Title:   Lead Account Manager, Enablement Partner   Job Description:    The Role:   Principal Account Manager, Enablement Partner   The person will be responsible for managing and growing existing business by collaborating closely with the Business Units, Customer Service, Technical Support, Quality, Production, and Sales Support teams. This role involves forecasting revenue, ensuring on-time delivery, and, when necessary, expediting product deliveries to enhance customer satisfaction. Additionally, the candidate will work closely with the Account Management team to identify, develop, and lead selected new business opportunities based on account priorities, product scope, and candidate capability, including CMP slurry, pads, Post-CMP cleans, and adjacent semiconductor materials and solutions. This role will serve as a dedicated Customer Enablement partner focused on sustaining existing business, improving customer experience, supporting market share expansion from the installed base, selectively leading new business development opportunities, and strengthening commercial execution through forecast discipline, allocation visibility, PCN horizon planning, AR issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.   Primary Responsibilities and Duties:      Lead and manage existing customer business across Entegris’ broad portfolio of products and solutions, including CMP slurry, pads, Post-CMP cleans, and related semiconductor process materials, supporting sustained growth, customer satisfaction, and stronger commercial execution.   Own sustained existing business management, including revenue protection, recurring demand visibility, customer satisfaction, and share-of-wallet expansion within current programs.   Orchestrate Entegris’ assets, resources, and systems to deliver a state-of-the-art customer experience when customers use Entegris solutions and products.   Manage product forecasting, allocation, on-time delivery, and expedite requests.   Develop and maintain a rolling 18-month forecast view in partnership with customers, Account Management, Business Units, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to improve planning accuracy and reduce supply risk.   Market share gains from existing business.   Contribute to revenue growth through strategic collaboration with the Account Management team on new business development.   Lead enablement service standards for key customers by proactively managing allocation constraints, order blocks, expedite requests, DOI oversight, PCN readiness, and AR-related issue resolution.   Drive revenue growth and achieve or exceed sales targets for existing business.   Lead and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams, including Product Marketing, Quality, Application Engineering, and Customer Support, to sustain ongoing business operations.   Maintain a strong understanding of market share and use this insight to prioritize growth opportunities.   Use technical expertise to accurately identify customer issues

title: Client Experience Manager - Emporio Armani Milano
description: Descrizione lavoro:   The Armani Group is a leading company in the fashion and luxury sector, with more than 8,000 employees. Its three core brands – Giorgio Armani, Emporio Armani and A|X Armani Exchange – are active in all the world’s major countries, across many continents. With origins firmly rooted in Italy, but also with a cosmopolitan vision and culture, the company has grown since it was founded in 1975, expanding its offer from clothes and accessories to cosmetics, fragrances, eyewear, watches, jewellery, and furniture and furnishing accessories. Today, therefore, as well as being well known in the area of fashion, the Armani Group is also renowned in the sectors of interior design, food and beverage, and hotels and resorts.  Giorgio Armani has created a style that has, with remarkable consistency, continued to explore countless variations and possibilities over the years. The Armani style, in expressing a precise vision – down to the most minute detail, is a style in the truest sense of the word: a way of being and presenting oneself, certainly incorporating clothing and accessories, but also including gestures, ways, behaviours and attitudes; a style that goes beyond the sum of its parts, and well beyond what one wears.  Convinced that ethics and aesthetics must coincide, Giorgio Armani expresses fundamental and enduring values through style. He does so by creating timeless pieces that, enhanced by precious materials and artisanal craftwork, resist the whim of fleeting trends with their pure and essential design.       Context and purpose of the job    Within our Emporio Armani flagship store in Milan, the Client Experience Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring that daily store operations translate into a seamless, elevated client journey that is fully aligned with the brand’s core values, heritage, and identity. title: Growth Manager
description: Letar du efter en arbetsplats för framtiden?   På Telenor bygger vi framtidens uppkopplade samhälle. Varje dag hjälper vi företag att växa genom smarta lösningar inom mobil kommunikation, nätverk, säkerhet och digitalisering.  Nu söker vi en Growth Manager med ansvar för två av våra viktigaste tillväxtsegment. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera analys, marknadsföring och försäljning för att skapa verklig affärseffekt. Du identifierar tillväxtmöjligheter, utvecklar segmentanpassade budskap, erbjudanden och kampanjer. Du har stort fokus på att driva digital försäljning och digitala leads. Du optimerar konvertering från första kontakt till affär.  Du arbetar nära Segment Manager, sälj, digitala kanaler och Martech-team för att säkerställa att vi attraherar fler kunder, ökar konverteringen och skapar hållbar tillväxt.  Rollen är en del av Customer Growth Management-teamet och rapporterar till Head of Customer Growth Management.  I rollen ansvarar du bland annat för att:  Driva tillväxt    Identifiera nya tillväxtmöjligheter baserat på kunddata, marknadsinsikter och affärsresultat.  Ansvarar för behovsframställan, prioritering och kravställning av säljstödjande kommunikations- och kampanj-koncept    Digital försäljning och Leadsgenerering    Planera och genomföra kampanjer och aktiviteter som genererar kvalificerade leads och ökar vår digitala försäljning  Arbeta nära säljorganisationen för att säkerställa effektiv leadsgenerering och hög konvertering.    Optimera kundresan    Analysera kundresor och identifiera förbättringsområden genom funneln.  Driva initiativ som förbättrar konvertering från intresse till affär.  Testa, mäta och optimera budskap, erbjudanden, kanaler och kundupplevelser.    Arbeta datadrivet    Följa upp resultat och KPI:er för efterfrågan, leads, konvertering och pipeline.  Omsätta data och insikter till konkreta förbättringsinitiativ.  Prioritera investeringar och aktiviteter utifrån affärspotential och effekt.    Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt    Arbeta nära Segment Managers för att säkerställa att aktiviteter stödjer segmentens mål och strategier.  Samarbeta med sälj, digitala kanaler, Martech för att skapa bästa möjliga resultat.  Bidra till lanseringar, erbjudandeutveckling och go-to-market-initiativ.     Är du den vi söker?   Vi söker dig som kombinerar affärsförståelse, analytisk förmåga och ett starkt resultatfokus.  Du drivs av att skapa tillväxt och gillar att använda data för att förstå vad som driver efterfrågan, konvertering och försäljning. Du är van att testa nya idéer, optimera aktiviteter löpande och omsätta insikter till initiativ som ger mätbara affärsresultat.  Du trivs i en miljö där du får stort eget ansvar och arbetar nära både affär, marknad och sälj

title: CRM Regional Manager
description: Purpose   Own customer complaint performance in the Central Region and represent the Company in direct dealings with the Ministry of Commerce head office and its Riyadh branch.   Responsibilities    Act as the Company's senior point of coordination with the Ministry head office and the Riyadh branch, maintaining direct working relationships with officials and inspectors.  Attend Ministry meetings, summons and field visits on behalf of the department, and provide the Company position with supporting evidence.  Own complaint performance for the Central Region — volume, resolution time, escalation rate and compensation exposure.  Conduct on-site verification at branches for disputed and high-value cases before a response is issued. Monitor branch compliance with mandatory documentation standards, including repair agreement completeness and Arabic issuance. Approve settlements within the delegated financial limit.  Request documentation and technical statements directly from branches.

title: Guest Experience

Develop and maintain guest service standards, operating procedures and service level agreements across all customer touchpoints. title: Partner Engagement Manager, Vicenza
description: Consequential Work. Dedicated People.    About Onebrief   Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.  Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.  We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.  Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.  Required: Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI  In person in Vicenza, Italy  Why This Role Exists  As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.  What You’ll Do  Core responsibilities:    Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.  Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.  Lead or support exercises.  Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.  Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.  When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.  Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.  Enable expansion and upsell opportunities to Allies and Partners by instilling the Onebrief value proposition.      Minimum Qualifications     Proven experience in leading operational plan

title: Kreativ och affärsdriven Facility Manager/Key Account Manager till ISS
description: ISS är ett av världens största tjänsteföretag och i år firar vi 80 år i Sverige! Med över 6500 medarbetare i landet, från norr till söder, levererar vi service som gör skillnad. Tjänsten är 100% tillsvidareanställning, med en inledande provanställning på 6 månader.      Ditt ansvar    Utveckla och stärka långsiktiga kundrelationer  Ansvara för budget, resultat och tillväxt  Säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveransen och kundupplevelsen  Identifiera och driva nya affärsmöjligheter  Leda, coacha och utveckla Service Managers och medarbetare  Driva förbättrings- och förändringsarbete  Bidra till att utveckla framtidens arbetsplats- och servicekoncept    Vem söker vi?     Du älskar service och människor och har ett starkt kommersiellt driv. Du är självgående, har ett starkt driv och en förmåga att skapa förtroende. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och motiveras av att leverera resultat.   Vi ser gärna att du har:   2–4 års erfarenhet av försäljning, account management eller liknande roll   Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att driva affärer och nå uppsatta mål   Stark kommunikativ förmåga och duktig på att bygga relationer   Erfarenhet av CRM-system och Officepaketet   Körkort och möjlighet att resa i tjänsten        Om Nordic Finance   Vi är ett snabbväxande finansbolag som hjälper företag att växa –genom smarta lösningar för finansiering av utrustning och maskiner. Vår styrka är vår flexibilitet, vår kompetens och vår passion för entreprenörskap.    Hos oss får du ansvar och utrymme att påverka vårt arbete med innehåll på riktigt. Du blir del av en arbetsmiljö där människor trivs och där beslutsvägarna är korta.      Praktisk information    Placering: Göteborg  Urval sker löpande.  Start enligt överenskommelse.

title: CX Manager
description: [회사 소개]  메딜리티는 약사 출신 창업자의 고민에서 탄생했습니다.      현재 약국 업무 환경에서는 알약 수기 계수, 조제 파우치 육안 검수 등 단순 반복적인 업무들이 상당 부분을 차지하고 있습니다. 메딜리티는 AI 기술을 통한 디지털 전환으로 약국의 일상적 업무 부담을 줄임으로써, 약사가 환자 케어에 더욱 집중할 수 있는 건강한 의료 환경을 만들어가고자 합니다.      AI 기반 알약 카운팅 솔루션 "필아이"는 전 세계 누적 가입자 90만 명, 월간 활성 사용자 15만 명을 확보하며 꾸준한 성장세를 보이고 있습니다. 메딜리티는 필아이를 시작으로 의약품 검수, 재고 관리를 아우르는 약국 운영의 통합 플랫폼을 만들어가고 있습니다.        [ 포지션 개요 ]  고객이 PillEye를 처음 문의하는 순간부터 제품을 받아 사용하고, 이후 구독을 갱신하기까지의 여정이 원활하게 이어지도록 실행을 책임지는 포지션입니다.     CX Lead가 설계한 체계를 바탕으로 고객 응대와 운영 실무를 수행하고, 실제 업무 과정에서 발견한 개선점을 함께 반영하며 체계를 고도화합니다. 고객 문의 대응부터 온보딩, 구독 관리, 글로벌 물류 운영까지 고객 경험의 전 과정을 폭넓게 경험할 수 있습니다.        [ 합류하시면 이런 일을 함께 합니다 ]   • 고객 대응: Intercom, 이메일, 유선 채널을 통해 들어오는 국내외 고객 문의에 1차 대응하고 VOC를 분류하고 기록합니다.  • 고객 관리: B2B 및 B2C 고객의 온보딩을 지원하고, 구독 갱신과 연간 전환을 안내하며 Salesforce를 기반으로 고객 데이터를 관리합니다.  • 운영 실행: 제품 출고, 배송, 반품, 재고 및 디바이스 현황을 관리하고 운영 과정에서 발생하는 결제를 처리합니다. 반복 업무는 문서화하고 더 효율적인 방식으로 개선합니다.        [ 자격요건 ]  • 고객 응대, 고객 관리 또는 고객 경험 관련 직무에서 1년 이상의 실무 경험  • 고객 문의의 맥락을 정확히 파악하고, 명확한 구조와 적절한 톤으로 답변할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 역량  • 문의나 주문이 매일 들어오는 환경에서 여러 업무를 동시에 처리해본 경험  • 반복 업무를 매뉴얼이나 템플릿으로 표준화하고, 다양한 업무 도구를 활용해 업무 방식을 개선해본 경험        [ 우대사항 ]  • Intercom 등 고객상담 솔루션과 Salesforce, Jira 등 CRM·티켓팅 툴 활용 경험  • 제품 출고, 배송, 반품 등 물류 운영 경험  • 헬스케어 또는 의료 관련 서비스의 고객 응대 경험  • 업무 프로세스의 비효율을 발견하고 개선을 주도한 경험  • 해외 고객 또는 파트너와의 비즈니스 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량        [ 업무 환경을 소개합니다 ]  • 선릉역 도보 3분 이내 거리에 위치해서 출퇴근이 편리합니다.  • 9시-11시 사이에 자유롭게 출근 일 8시간 근무하는 자율출근제를 채택하고 있습니다.  • 월/금 오피스 출근을 권장하며 화-목은 자유롭게 재택근무가 가능합니다.  • 자유로운 연차/반차 사용이 보장 됩니다.  • 업무에 필요한 장비 및 소프트웨어를 지원해 드립니다.        [ 제공하는 혜택과 복지에 대해 안내드립니다 ]  • 3년 만근시 유급 리프레쉬 휴가 30일이 제공됩니다.  • 금액 제한 없는 점심 식사와 간식을 지원드립니다.  • 업무에 필요한 도서 및 교육비를 지원해 드립니다.  • 연 1회 종합 건강검진을 지원합니다.  • 명절과 생일에는 소정의 선물을 제공합니다.        [ 채용전형 ]  • 서류 접수 ＞ 직무 인터뷰 ＞ 문화 적합성 인터뷰 ＞ 처우 협의 ＞ 최종 합격 및 입사  ◦ 상황에 따라 일부 면접 과정이 생략되거나 추가될 수 있습니다.  ◦ 직무 인터뷰에서는 20분 내외의 간단한 서면 과제가 진행됩니다.  ◦ 필요에 따라 채용 과정에서 레퍼런스 체크가 추가로 진행될 수 있습니다.  • 최종 합격 후 3개월의 수습 기간이 있으며, 이 기간 동안 급여는 100% 지급합니다

title: Manufacturing Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engin

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote

The impact you will have:

Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

You are also the technical point of contact for your customers. You might have heard about us, but with a different name: ZnanyLekarz. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. title: Freelancer Technical Recruiter
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives
